Name: Sapling Brand
Description: "Even the mightiest warriors share humble beginnings."

Name: Overseer's Insight
Description: "There is much to learn about commanding others. For one, never give them a chance to get their swords out first."

Name: The Deckhand
Description: "Gets the job done, but could probably use a good wash."

Name: Overseer's Edge
Description: "There is nothing like a blade to give the overseer an edge over their workers. Especially if they always keep that edge sharp."

Name: Dark Path
Description: "This sword was cast aside for greater power...and greater corruption."

Name: Briarmaw
Description: "Those who trouble themselves to cut through briars often have the sense to take the long way back."

Name: Dark Tidings
Description: "There is trouble brewing on the horizon. I can smell it on the wind."

Name: Effervescence
Description: "Take a deep breath. Find the darkness within yourself, and let a boiling rage fill your heart."

Name: Eye Of Darkness
Description: "Look too long into this blade, and you'll learn things about yourself you never wanted to know."

Name: First Contact
Description: "He gently placed the crude blade in one of the Stranger's four hands. The Stranger smiled."

Name: Forgotten Memory
Description: "This worn blade has seen thousands of years pass and nearly as many wielders."

Name: Frigid Gale
Description: "Best bring furs. The chill cuts to the bone."

Name: Moonlit Dance
Description: "The fireflies danced along the reflective surface, unaware of the carnage to come."

Name: Mountain Thorn
Description: Years of Azoth pulsing through the mountain's core have honed this sediment into a deadly edge.

Name: One Last Breath
Description: "Is this how they will remember you sputtering and gasping for air?"

Name: Phoenix Ashes
Description: "I will rise again, more powerful than before."

Name: Prismatic Vista
Description: "Hold it up to the light, I think you'll like what you find."

Name: Pure of Heart
Description: "Many a knight have crashed against their dragons. Many a knight have failed."

Name: Runecarved Blade
Description: "The artistry of the Ancients lives on through this blade. Perhaps there's some meaning to it."

Name: Sanguine Crook
Description: "So sway others you must win their hearts, but sometimes taking a heart does just as well."

Name: Subservience
Description: "Only those who have the uncompromising will to obey shall wield this blade."

Name: Valor's Beginnings
Description: "This blade, much like its original wielder, is more suited to cut wheat than demons."

Name: Morning Dew
Description: "Their blood shall scatter like so many droplets in the morning mist."

Name: Captain's Command
Description: "With a single stroke of the sword, Captain Hamidou laid rest to all arguments against their command."

Name: Vile Longblade
Description: "A grotesque amalgamation of metal and bone."

Name: Swordbound Malikor
Description: "Was Malikor bound to the sword, or was the sword bound to him?"

Name: Tidal Reaver
Description: "Be mindful of your will. If left unchecked, you'll find yourself cutting through your foes as a galleon through a wave."

Name: The First of Many
Description: "This is your blade. Cherish it. If you are lucky, it will not last long."

Name: Flutter
Description: “Light was her step and quick was her blade. Like bird on the wind her opponent dismayed.”

Name: Balance of Time
Description: "Dedication to a craft is only as valuable as your ability to step away from it."

Name: Lost Mercy
Description: "I spared someone once. I won't make the same mistake again."

Name: Overseer's Hunger
Description: "Nothing can sate the Overseer's desire for more control over the world."

Name: Drowned Mariners Chanty
Description: “Bring us a tale of good winds and glory / Way ho, we're off to Aeternum / Sing us a song, a wonderous story / Way ho, we're off to Aetrnum”

Name: Ursine Will
Description: "Blades honed from the hide of a terra bear are said to imbue the weilder with the spirit's power."

Name: Cauterizer
Description: "Not a drop of blood lost."

Name: Bloodforged Longsword
Description: "This blade passes from battlefield to battlefield, finding a new wielder each time."

Name: Decrepit
Description: "Eventually, everything withers into nothing."

Name: Diamond's Edge
Description: "The smith held the sword aloft and whispered one word to herself: Flawless."

Name: Enchantress
Description: "This sword was given to me by your mother, whose mother gave it to her, and so on, since before the books kept track of such things."

Name: First Mate's Blade
Description: "I found her, long though lost to the sea. There she was in the sand, not a spec of rust on her."

Name: G.R.E.G
Description: "When Geraldine Rebekah Elizabeth Gulliver carved her initials into the handle of this sword, it occurred to her that, should someone find it, they might think it was wielded by a man. She chuckled at the thought."

Name: Grim Harbinger
Description: "Brace yourself. The battle has only just begun."

Name: Immortal Flame
Description: "It is said this sword cuts through flesh as if it were a hot knife slicing through butter."

Name: Jenning's Fury
Description: "Nothin' makes me feel more alive than personally holdin' open Death's door for you to step through."

Name: Memory of the First Ones
Description: "What was once a rudimentary blade now hums with Azoth-infused power."

Name: Natural Formation
Description: "There are no hammer marks or imperfections. It's as if it sprung from the earth itself, ready to fight alongside you."

Name: Noble's Decorative Sword
Description: "My father gave me this, hoping I would never use it. I managed not to. Will you?"

Name: Obsidian Slasher
Description: "Though many think obsidian to be brittle, a skilled smith can create the deadliest of weapons with it."

Name: Quick Wit
Description: "A sharp mind is nothing without a sharper blade."

Name: Sacrosanct
Description: "Stand ready, for the demons do not tarry."

Name: Sign of Salvation
Description: "Do not fear. To meet my blade is to meet your true purpose."

Name: Steel to Blood
Description: "Not exactly a science, but it'll do."

Name: Those Who Remain
Description: "As life slips through our fingers, we find ourselves longing ever more for those we love."

Name: Valor's Call
Description: "The farmhand took one look back at their village They would not return without tales of glory."

Name: Frelav's Faith
Description: Frelav's standard issue shortsword, though this one has never seen use.

Name: Keelhaul
Description: "If the blade doesn't get ya, the barnacles will."

Name: Keen Temper
Description: "Hone thyself, straight and sharp, and find that no obstacle will ever again be too great."

Name: Remorseless Winter
Description: “Only the most hearty may survive the frost of winter.”

Name: Brilliant Refraction
Description: "The blade bends the flow of combat as easily as it bends the light."

Name: Eye of the Storm
Description: "They say the eye of the storm is where it is calmest. They haven't met my blade."

Name: Lordsbane
Description: "Sometimes, the final blow of a battle falls before the battle even starts."

Name: Deep Hatred
Description: "I will find you, and I will end you."

Name: Dowsing Blade
Description: "It guides its wielder to their truest desire."

Name: Infallible Pursuit
Description: “We never imagined being right would be our downfall."

Name: Soulseeker
Description: "Press your ear to the blade. Can you hear the wailing souls?"

Name: Noble's Brand
Description: "All the elegance of a noble, and all the viciousness too."

Name: Symbiote's Brand
Description: "The dryad is a curious creature, is it a man-formed plant or a plant-formed man?"

Name: Captain's Fury
Description: "Any soul foolish enough to question the Captain quickly found themselves marooned... or worse."

Name: Shatterslash
Description: "Don't touch the blade. Ever. Even the flat of the blade will cut you."

Name: Unceremonious End
Description: "My you breathe your last surrounded by those you love, and those who love you."

Name: The Cause
Description: "Carry this blade as a symbol of your dedication and unwavering loyalty to the Company."

Name: A Thousand Cuts
Description: "The grip is wrapped in a biting hemp rope, unfit for soft hands."

Name: Coral Lash
Description: "When faced wtih a shortage of steel, the Siren's crew had to get creative."

Name: Coral Lash
Description: "When faced wtih a shortage of steel, the Siren's crew had to get creative."

Name: Aphedia
Description: “Sound of mind. Resolute in purpose. Reborn of Azoth.”

Name: Arm of the Aggressor
Description: "You shall be the first to wet your blade with the blood of your enemies."

Name: Echoes of War
Description: "I fought valiently, and yet they are gone. Have I failed?"

Name: Enigmatic Aeons
Description: "Run your finger along the blade. Can you feel it pulse with the stars themselves?"

Name: Fearful Breath
Description: "It will be sharp and cold when you inhale. That is the taste of fear."

Name: Ghastly Revelation
Description: "To be slain, only to open your eyes and find yourself bound to a world which rejected you, is a cursed fate indeed."

Name: Gift from the Mother
Description: “We do not ask of Her and yet She provides. Such gifts do not go unreturned."

Name: Gracious Host
Description: "I alone will show them how unexpected guests should be treated."

Name: Gravebreaker
Description: "This blade was burried with its weilder... and the wielder before that... and before that."

Name: Grim Edict
Description: “You will join us, or you will die.”

Name: Hastate
Description: "The Razor Tree springs to life once a millennium, awakened by the natural Azoth cycle. As it re-enters slumber, it sheds leaves sharper than a smith's blade."

Name: Justicar
Description: "To dedicate one's life to defending the helpless, what could be more noble than that?"

Name: Muffled Wail
Description: "How could one put so many to the sword?"

Name: Soulfire Damascus
Description: "Blades forged in soulfire cut deeper than flesh. The wounds they leave follow you into the afterlife."

Name: True Path
Description: "Give no regard to those who wander; they are already lost."

Name: Valor's Destiny
Description: "The farmhand's destiny was now. They gripped their blade and charged into the fray."

Name: Visions of Chaos
Description: "They call to me, tell me the truth, open my eyes."

Name: Kindness
Description: "I've always wanted to actually kill someone with kindness."

Name: Tempest of Torment
Description: "My blade shall rain down; a relentless hurricane, a torrent of torment."

Name: Crimson Vow
Description: "As you wrap your blade in this crimson cloth, give thanks for all It has given. The Power to conquer. The True Sight to believe. And the Will to march forth."

Name: Eternal Servitude
Description: "With this blade, we grant you the power and life to rise again forever more."

Name: Masterstroke
Description: "For years the smith honed her craft. At long last, she succeeded. The perfect blade."

Name: Opus Blade
Description: "My muse sings a song of death. I simply transcribe it."

Name: Void-Forged Harbinger
Description: "Towns, cities, nations. All are yours to conquer."

Name: Emberstrike
Description: "Forged in the depths of Shattered Mountain, this sword appears as if it is molten lava bound together by some unknown magic."

Name: Isabella's Chosen
Description: "I hope you find what you are looking for."

Name: Whisper of the Wood
Description: "Be as the wind flowing through the wyrdwood grove."

Name: Abomination's Mandible
Description: "This 'sword' appears to be the sharpened jaw of some massive creature."

Name: Al'kazor
Description: "The gem adorned hilt glistens as the rest of the blade seems to consume the light. What was once a righteous sword has now succumbed to pure corruption, just as its former master has."

Name: Anakor, Gaze of Serpents
Description: “When it emerged from the pool, they looked upon what they had wrought. A monstrosity with the power of a god."

Name: A Thousand Voices
Description: "As you grip the handle you can hear them... Or are those your thoughts?"

Name: Blazing Reaver
Description: "As hot as the sun and as light as a feather."

Name: Bloodline Heir
Description: "An intricate set of engraved capillaries allow it to siphon blood over the surface of the blade."

Name: Break Beyond
Description: "We are only limited by what we choose to believe."

Name: Brinelash
Description: “Salt crusts the blade, giving it a jagged edge. It's still not as salty as your opponent.”

Name: Ciradim, Charge of the Guardian
Description: "The wooded serpent guarded Aeternum for eons. That charge now falls upon you."

Name: Dryad's Demise
Description: "You see, the trick to killing Dryads is a sharp edge and fire. Lots and lots of fire."

Name: Emerald's Eye
Description: "Crafted from a colossal emerald, this weapon hardly seems practical."

Name: Final Waltz
Description: "Come, let us dance. You can follow my lead."

Name: Formal Invitation
Description: "You are cordially invited to 'Catch These Hands' tomorrow at 12 PM sharp."

Name: Frostbite
Description: "Touching the metal is enough to freeze off a finger."

Name: Fulgurite Slasher
Description: “The Siren's followers scattered across the beach, gathering glass to forge, and taking care to avoid the freshly fried challenger.”

Name: Gravescraper
Description: “They can keep crawling out of their hole, I'll be here to put them back in.”

Name: Greenkeeper
Description: "Tame the wilds."

Name: Soulwarden's Guide
Description: "The Soulwardens dare not venture beyond the Cleave without their trusty friend at their side.'

Name: Grovewarden
Description: "With your hand on the wyrdwood grip, you feel an aura of clarity and purpose."

Name: Guardian's Charge
Description: "Long held by the guard captain of Amarine Temple, it is unknown how this battlescarred blade ended up in the hands of humans."

Name: Hatred's Bite
Description: "Let it be done! Strike down your foes, unleash your wrath!"

Name: Hemogoblin
Description: “The blade shutters and shakes with delight as it carves into its prey.”

Name: Illusory Enigma
Description: "... They opened that door, only to find yet another door. But not one to be out done..."

Name: Illusory Enigma
Description: "... They opened that door, only to find yet another door. But not one to be out done..."

Name: Jupiter's Favor
Description: “Lord of the heavens, grant me your boon, that I might smight these unworthy souls.”

Name: Killer Instinct
Description: "I'm afraid your path ends here."

Name: Lane's Lament
Description: "Woe unto me, for my burdens are many. My friends, though, are many more!"

Name: Liberator Of Souls
Description: “Be free, now, of your fleshbound prison. Rest until we meet again."

Name: Luminous Dream
Description: "Light from the moon scatters upon the ground, each fragment showing a different world."

Name: Malicious Intent
Description: "The road to hell is paved with good intentions."

Name: Malum
Description: "Unleash chaos."

Name: Moonless Night
Description: "The only way to find me is to look when there are only stars to guide you."

Name: Moonless Night
Description: "The only way to find me is to look when there are only stars to guide you."

Name: Pit Lord Dominator
Description: "This sword is forged in the fires of hatred and tempered with the blood of the cruel."

Name: Rallying Cry
Description: "To me, my friends! Victory is almost ours!"

Name: Reckless
Description: "Power over precision."

Name: Reconciliation
Description: "We hated each other for a long time. We didn't speak to each other. Until one day, we didn't and we did."

Name: Rimeblade
Description: "The hungering cold consumes all."

Name: Seaborne Plague
Description: "We look across these vast waters, wondering what treasures and adventures it may hold for us. In truth, it holds only sorrow and death."

Name: Second Chance
Description: "You have been given a second opportunity. Do not squander it."

Name: Seeker of Secrets
Description: "It pierces to the soul and siphons the truth."

Name: Seer's End
Description: "Gaze deep within my crystal sword; in it you will find your death."

Name: Shard Of The Obelisk
Description: "This fragment of the Obelisk still hums and shakes in the presence of Azoth, as if threatening to shatter once more."

Name: Sin
Description: "With our righteous fury we shall purge the corrupted."

Name: Slicing Zephyr
Description: "What you can't see, CAN kill you."

Name: Spirithound
Description: "The blade hungers for souls. Not of the living, but of those who refuse to rest."

Name: Surrogate of Justice
Description: "The only justice one can hope to receive in this acursed world is their end."

Name: Tempest
Description: "Batten the hatches, the storm comes for you."

Name: The Black Blade
Description: "Once owned by a dark knight, this weapon has caused many evils in its life."

Name: The Captain's Deal
Description: “A thousand notches on a dead man's blade. Only a thousand more to go.”

Name: The Fairy Queens Jest
Description: “In stories, fae-folk were well known for their playful nature. The same cannot be said for their civility.”

Name: The Familiar
Description: "It's a bit unconventional, but at least it doesn't knock flasks off my table."

Name: The Messenger
Description: “We are not enemies you and I. We are but ants playing at war upon the table of gods.”

Name: The Way Home
Description: “Should you find yourself lost, follow the leylines. They will guide you homeward.”

Name: Untrodden Path
Description: "Step away from what you know. Walk willfully. You will find the way."

Name: Valor's Folly
Description: "The corrupted soldier retrieved his trophy from the farmhand's corpse."

Name: Verdant Agony
Description: “Edengrove cries out in pain, you must defend her.”

Name: Vinesnapper
Description: "An ancient sword fashioned from crude metals and wound with branches. After all these years, it's as lethal as ever."

Name: Voice of the Makers
Description: "We have seen your deeds, and we are not impressed."

Name: Volcanic Reaver
Description: "Obsidian is not a material sought after by nobles. But the warriors who wield it can cause catostrophic damage with its razor sharp edges."

Name: Warden of the Wilds
Description: "Long has the Warden of the Wilds been passed from keeper to keeper, each charged with protecting the natural beauty of Aeternum."

Name: Widowmaker
Description: "We shall meet again in this life or the next."

Name: Wildfire
Description: "A single spark can ignite the flame that engulfs the world."

Name: Will of the Hunter
Description: “Feel their tension. Hear their heartbeat. Taste their fear."

Name: Wishful Wail
Description: "Try as we might, we cannot grasp the cruel hands of fate."

Name: Deeproot
Description: "The older the tree, the stronger the magic."

Name: Infernus
Description: After the Covenant were driven from their homeland, this holy sword is said to have descended from the heavens to help them take it back.

Name: Timekeeper's Hand
Description: "Lost and recovered many times through the ages, the initials of each wielder is etched along the blade - F, G, P, P, A, E, Z, N, K, L, S."

Name: Guardian's Resolve
Description: A firm resolution to protect your Lord fills your body when you grip its hilt.

Name: Protector's Fury
Description: A furious rage builds within.

Name: Scorpio
Description: "You can almost see the stars in the reflection of the blade."

Name: Shadow's Edge
Description: Thinner than a thought, quicker than the light.

Name: Risen Brilliance
Description: This blade captures the radiance of the sunrise.

Name: Spitting Fang
Description: The blade's bite comes with a hiss of potent venom.

Name: Borrowed Blade
Description: This weapon is not free but loaned on credit. The red boat sinks and the golden heroes rise; when this comes to pass, he will collect payment.

Name: Stratagem
Description: Everyone has a plan until they get stabbed in the face.

Name: Farmer Russo's Rusty Great Axe
Description: "Sometimes a pitchfork ain't enough to keep the Lost at bay."

Name: Earth Battered Axe
Description: "This axe has seen better days after being carried all around the world."

Name: Crimson King
Description: "Royal blood flows like any other blood, fastest from a severed limb."

Name: Stormforged Waraxe
Description: "It was a dark and dreary night when the smith created this weapon. A torrential downpour nearly flooded her workshop."

Name: Dreadweaver
Description: "Do you fear me now?"

Name: Ancient Great Axe
Description: "Brought to Aeternum with the Ancients, and now left behind."

Name: Axe of the Vast Caverns
Description: “Look down. Can you see the bottom?”

Name: Colossal Wood Axe
Description: "A massive axe, hand crafted from enchanted wood."

Name: Corrupted Hulking Battleaxe
Description: "Despite the massive size of this weapon, the void seems to make it somewhat lighter to carry."

Name: Empowered Great Axe
Description: "The Archmage always did say to enchant your weapons."

Name: Flaming Great Axe
Description: "Hot off the forge."

Name: Fleshripping Great Axe
Description: "A single cut will not suffice."

Name: Hulking Great Axe
Description: "Why would anyone need an axe this large."

Name: Journeyman Smith's Battleaxe
Description: "It was not the first axe he had crafted, but it was his finest."

Name: Lamb Slaughter
Description: “You shall be my sacrifice.”

Name: Limb Splitter
Description: "Leg bone disconnects from the hip bone. Arm bone disconnects from the shoulder bone..."

Name: Massive Frosty Axe
Description: "The edge of the axe is a dark blue hue, much different than the steel present elsewhere."

Name: Mob Rule
Description: "We know you are innocent, but this crowd is here to see a beheading."

Name: Overweight Great Axe
Description: "Not particularly well balanced and a bit unwieldy, but it'll get the job done."

Name: Ruiner
Description: "Whatever you strike with this blade will never be the same."

Name: Vinewrapped Great Axe
Description: "Roots reach forth from the hilt to the head of the axe."

Name: Voidridden Great Axe
Description: "Touched by the void."

Name: Wavecrushing Waraxe
Description: "Stand strong against the tide."

Name: Farmhand's Axe
Description: The edge is a bit dulled from being used for woodchopping, though don't tell Willette that.

Name: Timereaver
Description: "Where am I? When am I?"

Name: Silent Great Axe
Description: "She swung her axe and I heard not a sound."

Name: Queen Killer
Description: "Empires rise and fall. Mostly they fall to the cleaving of a great axe."

Name: Great Axe of the Colossal Breach
Description: "I had never seen a portal quite so big. Instantly I was filled with dread. What would emerge from the swirling void?"

Name: Snaggletooth's Fang
Description: "A gnarled fang makes for a ruthless weapon."

Name: Grand Executioner's Aid
Description: "Your crimes are absolute. Your punishment is death."

Name: Stormbinder's Great Axe
Description: "Lightning, to me!"

Name: Harbinger's Call
Description: "Hear my cry and know that I am with you."

Name: Tipping Point
Description: "We debated, then we argued. We prepared, then we invaded."

Name: Cannoneer
Description: “Wood can be sharpened to such a fine point that it is as effective as steel.”

Name: Axe of the First Culling
Description: "The first time they came to my village, they took ten of us. They promised the next time would be far worse."

Name: Battleaxe of the Forgotten One
Description: "She was left to guard the sanctum while her fellow soldiers went scavenging. They never returned, and she still stands there guarding it to this day."

Name: Beast's Burly Chopper
Description: "Strong enough to take down a tree in one swing."

Name: Breacher's Battleaxe
Description: "Whatever comes out of that portal needs to die."

Name: Cobweb Cleaver
Description: "Massive spiders leave massive webs and I do hate getting my hands dirty."

Name: Corrupted Brute's Waraxe
Description: "The corruption infused this man with extraordinary strength, making him quite the foe. The power with which he swung his axe was unmatched."

Name: Great Axe of the Flaming Forges
Description: "The black forges of Myrkgaard billow day and night, producing savage weaponry for the Tempest's forces."

Name: Hulking Arcane Axe
Description: "Which will kill you first, my magic or my axe?"

Name: Icestriker
Description: "Break through the glacial wall."

Name: Root's Axe
Description: "I am Root."

Name: Sharpened Anchor
Description: "Mariners are a resourceful lot. This weapon seems to have been an anchor for a small ship at one point, though it has since been sharpened to a formidabler greataxe."

Name: Tender Cruelty
Description: "A soldier knows all to well how comforting the scars of battle can be."

Name: Golden Axeperience
Description: "All that glitters is the keen edge of a great axe at your enemy's throat."

Name: Broadclaw
Description: "With a broad swipe of his claws, all his enemies fell down, never to stand again."

Name: Ice Cold Heartcleaver
Description: "First she tore at his limbs, then she tore at his heart."

Name: Star-eyed Reaper
Description: "Look to the stars as I bring a certain death to you."

Name: Spiteful Reaper
Description: "I kill you not because I need to, but because I disdain you."

Name: Timeripping Great Axe
Description: "Tear a hole through time and escape this reality."

Name: Executioner
Description: The arbiter of death is not spared the brutality of his actions; to cull life is akin to culling one’s own.

Name: Headsman
Description: "The weight does most of the work, as long as you keep the blade sharp, that is."

Name: Robber Baron's Great Axe
Description: "For years he stole from the poor. To return the favor, they stole his life."

Name: Stormherald
Description: "I am the storm."

Name: Hulking Berserker's Battleaxe
Description: "The berserker wielded two great axes, a feat that should not have been possible."

Name: Anatul's Rebirth
Description: "Death is not the end for me."

Name: Ancient Purifier
Description: "Cleanse the land with your blood."

Name: Axe of the Abomination
Description: "Stitched together and reborn in undeath, the abomination wielded an axe of massive proportions and cut down soldiers by the dozen."

Name: Bastion's Motivator
Description: "The last bastion before the corrupted frontier fought daily for their lives. Seeing the next sunrise was all they hoped for."

Name: Battleaxe of Precise Calculations
Description: "Well callibrated to an engineer's specifications, the razor sharp edge can cut through anything."

Name: Bloodspiller
Description: "Drink in the blood of your enemies."

Name: Breachshutter
Description: "Defend our settlement, close that breach!"

Name: Diamond's Edge Great Axe
Description: “Expensive.”

Name: Dryadic Greatcleaver
Description: "Few Dryads wield axes, but those that do wield them with such ferocity and vigor that it takes ten men to bring them down."

Name: Dryad's Weedcutting Axe
Description: "Cut them down."

Name: Endless Void
Description: “My wrath is as endless as the void. I shall never stop hunting you.”

Name: Fearwarden
Description: "Stand tall, for you have nothing to fear."

Name: Icy Decapitator
Description: "Either the cold will kill you or I will."

Name: Jotunbane
Description: "People say that giants are lost to time. I say they live on through the stories we tell."

Name: Ramu's Battleaxe
Description: "A well oiled axe can keep any adventurer alive."

Name: Reckless Abandon
Description: "Your carelessness may yet be what saves you."

Name: Soulbound Great Axe
Description: "This weapon is attuned to your soul. You and it are one."

Name: Time Sunderer
Description: “Where and when the Ancients came from remains a myster to this day. The weaponry they left behind was years ahead of what most humans can craft.”

Name: Unsung Hero
Description: "No one will remember his name, but we honor him every day by living."

Name: Voidreaver's Axe
Description: "The terror of the void shall wash over all the land."

Name: Warforged Reaper
Description: "She stood atop the wall looking down at the battle. With one step forward, she fell into the fray. What came next, well...it was screams of terror."

Name: Wretched Battleaxe
Description: “A horrific sight.”

Name: Platinum Star
Description: "No enemy in the world is impossible to overcome when you face them holding the strongest of weapons."

Name: Warrior's Breath
Description: "The roar was deafening. We looked across the battlefield and saw her, bold and bloodied. We were afraid."

Name: Pestilence
Description: "Great Axe of the First Horseman."

Name: Eternal Dusk
Description: "It is only in these moments that I feel our twilight lasts forever."

Name: Guillotine
Description: "The people shall have their say."

Name: Dark Sky
Description: "When they came, they brought with them an eternal darkness. We never saw the light again."

Name: Antique Battleaxe
Description: "This axe has to be hundreds of years old, but it still has its edge."

Name: Arcane Reaper
Description: "Hunting mages has never been more fun."

Name: Artisinal Great Axe
Description: "Never has a more fine axe been crafted."

Name: Axe of the Binding
Description: "We are one. Our fates are entertwined."

Name: Axe of the Cold Depths
Description: "The bottom of the ocean is as cold as the north pole."

Name: Axe of the Final War
Description: "We have fought wars our whole life, but none like this."

Name: Axe of the Forgotten Son
Description: "Forsaken by his family, all the soldier had left was the clothes on his back and the weapon in his hand."

Name: Balanced Destruction

Description: Only a fool would try to use such an impractical weapon.

Name: Radigah
Description: It was named, along with its sister, by their wielder. They have not been wielded together since they were lost.

Name: Watcher's Threat
Description: Those who wish to enforce something must be able to back up their position.

Name: The Receiver
Description: It thrums with a call from beyond.

Name: Smite from on High
Description: The heavens themselves shall strike you down.

Name: Singular
Description: A fiercely powerful weapon. The creator would argue it is all you'd need and named it as such.

Name: Vision
Description: Right before death the future can pass you by.

Name: Brutish Powder
Description: This gun doesn't use standard powder, but its effectiveness can't be disputed.

Name: Taggert
Description: It was named by a strange, little creature who came upon it. Only the namer knows what they bestowed upon it.

Name: Clearance
Description: For when you need some space.

Name: Feat of Engineering
Description: Be proud of your creations.

Name: Mayhem
Description: Neither friend nor foe appreciate it when this weapon is wielded.

Name: Big Shot
Description: "Are you sure that's gonna fit in the barrel?"

Name: Spooling Force
Description: It weaves the threads of your opponent's short-lived fate.

Name: Messy Splasher
Description: It was never intended to be precise, only effective.

Name: Fifth Floor
Description: Taken from a not-so-poor soul who was hunted by wolves in a frozen land. How did it end up so far from their resting place?

Name: Demonic Execution
Description: Once weakened, even terrible foes can be felled.

Name: Swathe Of Darkness
Description: Blanket your enemies in the void.

Name: Blinding Light
Description: Faced with the light, they can only move on.

Name: Brick Breaker
Description: This weapon fires with enough force to shatter stone.

Name: The Gardener
Description: The residents didn't quite care for the caretaker.

Name: Cannonade
Description: It used to just be a simple gun, until an excitable person picked it up. Now it's still just a simple gun but it has a cool name.

Name: Heaven's Crash
Description: "Careful with that, just the kick can splinter the sky."

Name: Furious Stampede
Description: Just like with a bull, you don't want to stand in front of this weapon.

Name: Sinner Slaying Gun
Description: Live by the sword, die by the gun.

Name: Blind Rage
Description: Rage with no outlet is a dangerous force seeking an opening.

Name: Colossi-Crumbler 4000
Description: If they get up, drop them again.

Name: Sulfurous Roar
Description: The smell of sulfur clings to one's clothes after firing this weapon.

Name: Symmetrical Talon
Description: This weapon roars like an enraged crocodile when fired.

Name: Boom Stick
Description: One shot, one kill

Name: War Cannon
Description: Point and shoot

Name: Vinnask
Description: This weapons thunderous roar reaches far and wide, signaling to all of Attalus' Knights that their Lord Commander is here, and victory is near.

Name: Venerable Recurve
Description: "To wield a bow is a privilege. You must shape the bow yourself, craft the arrows yourself, and honor your prey. Kill for need, not for want."

Name: Immoral Evermore
Description: "Volley after volley of arrows filled the sky, one for each sin committed."

Name: Lightning Strike
Description: "Your arrow should be like lightning. Blink and you miss it, gone in a flash of an eye."

Name: Tropical Storm
Description: "Fire volley after volley until the whole lot of them lay dead."

Name: Ancient Avenger
Description: "Let not my sacrifice be in vain. You are our last hope."

Name: Crystalline Compound Bow
Description: “Crystals protrude out from the limbs of the bow, adding a lethal and jagged edge.”

Name: Decorative Longbow
Description: "This belongs on a mantle."

Name: Enchanted Longbow
Description: "The strings vibrate as your fingers run up and down them. Magical energies are imbued deep within the sinew."

Name: Fallen Comrade
Description: "You may have his face, but you are not my brother."

Name: Gutpiercer
Description: "Designed to inflict maximum pain."

Name: Ice-threaded Longbow
Description: "The icey tendrils are pervasive, piercing into the heart of the bow."

Name: Moonshot
Description: "Aim for the moon, and if you miss, you land amongst the crushing empty void."

Name: Needle Threader
Description: "Firing an arrow is like threading a needle through a fine linen. You must be perfect lest you ruin the whole tapestry."

Name: Phoenix Feather Recurve
Description: "The string of the bow is said to be crafted from the feathers of a phoenix. Just as the string begins to get worn out, it appears again as fresh as the day the bow was made."

Name: Regent's Hunting Bow
Description: "Eventually you will grow tired of hunting boars. It is then that you will seek out the most dangerous game; man."

Name: Steel Amalgamation
Description: "Rivets and bolts hold this monstrosity together. The weight alone makes the bow less than practical."

Name: True Sight
Description: "Close your eyes and let loose your arrow."

Name: Unseen Observer
Description: "We stay concealed so that we may learn."

Name: Vinewarped Longbow
Description: "Vines have grown around the limbs of the bow as it lay unused for decades."

Name: Whisper of Faith
Description: "When you loose, have faith your arrow will fly true. Do not hesitate with doubt."

Name: Whisp of the Woods
Description: "The arrows came as if out of no where. One moment, nothing, the next, only death."

Name: Willette's Bow
Description: "Kept me safe for many years now, nice and practical."

Name: Soul of the Storm
Description: "Though a thousand deaths will take my mind, I leave this bow to reap my vengeance a thousand fold."

Name: Thread of Fate
Description: "If seek your destiny by following threads of fate, you will be disappointed."

Name: Bow of the Dark Ranger
Description: "They saw only a hooded figure with glowing red eyes. The very next moment they found an arrow lodged in their heart."

Name: Fury's Call
Description: "When I give the order to loose your arrow, let it fly true and strike down our enemies."

Name: Bow of the Shadows
Description: "Do not let the light see what you do in the dark."

Name: Fae Ranger's Longbow
Description: "While the faefolk haven't been seen for centuries, legends still circulate about their cunning rangers and their prowess with a bow."

Name: Last Gasp
Description: "The vines pulled him lower and lower into the earth. He shot a flaming arrow up at the tree, hoping for a final chance at life."

Name: Noble's Hunting Bow
Description: "For when you need to prove your prowess and wealth."

Name: Adventurer's Bane
Description: "Particularly good at piercing knee armor."

Name: Boneforged Recurve
Description: "The limbs of the bow are made of human bone. And the string feels... fleshy."

Name: Corrupted Sight
Description: "It slowly wound the cloth around its face until it could not see. Still, it knew I was there."

Name: Cursed Longbow of the First Legion
Description: "This weapon has wrought death and destruction upon hundreds of civilizations. No good can come from wielding it."

Name: Driftwood Recurve
Description: "The pirates shaped the bow out of wood they found at sea. How lucky for them that they would come across imbued wyrdwood near the shores of Aeternum."

Name: Ebon Rain
Description: "The black arrows of the Corrupted armies are a warning of the bloodshed that is to come."

Name: Forgotten Song
Description: "The ghouls and gheists may have sang in life, but the only song they know now is their groans of agony."

Name: Fragile Death
Description: "Life is fleeting. Let loose one arrow and a light goes out in this cruel world."

Name: Glacial Recurve
Description: "Cold to the touch, the enchanted icey limbs prove to be a secure foundation for this bow."

Name: Inquisitor's Mark
Description: "Arrows fired from this bow brand their targets with a mark a trained Inquisitor can easily follow."

Name: Ley Line
Description: "The bow acts as a conduit, funneling arcane energy into itself."

Name: Lie of Omission
Description: "I did not tell you I killed him because I felt it to be of no consequence."

Name: Poisonstrike
Description: "My arrows will not kill you, no. You will die a slow and wretched death as my poison slowly eats away at your body."

Name: Sea Angel
Description: "As the rotting ship sank she let let loose her final arrow. On it, she tied a cry for help, now adrift upon the sea."

Name: Violent Gale
Description: "May the strong winds guide my arrow."

Name: Alvar's Sight
Description: Alvar's heartpiercing bow. Reliable and accurate.

Name: Rimestring
Description: "The bowstring is cold to the touch, and has a tendency to form frost on humid days."

Name: Faith Finder
Description: "It is said being wounded from this is crossbow is a sure way to discover your faith."

Name: Vicious Host
Description: "Guest right is a sacred thing in the world. To kill those you welcome into your own home... unthinkable."

Name: Void Needler
Description: "With pinpoint accuracy, the Dark Ranger could thread a void-tinged arrow into the heart of her prey."

Name: Omen
Description: "What fate awaits you?"

Name: Named Dryads Bow Of the Dryad and Dryad
Description: REPLACEME

Name: Taste of Grief
Description: "Each arrow causes as sharp a pain as an empty stomach, and the weakness that comes from too little food."

Name: Longbow of the Arcane Eye
Description: "As the mages practiced their incantations inside, archers lined the walls of the tower keeping watch on threats near and far."

Name: Fiery Temper
Description: "Quick to anger and quick to knock an arrow."

Name: Longbow of the Eternal Dream
Description: "We shall keep watch for as long as she sleeps."

Name: The Huntress
Description: This bow’s design is inspired by a legendary weapon, although it has a sentimental feeling as if it were the real thing.

Name: Frostfever
Description: "A boiling fever overtook him. Ironic, that he should die like this in such a cold place."

Name: Siren's Call
Description: "They heard her cry from afar and were lured to her shores. Their desire led them to a place of death."

Name: Twisted Horizon
Description: "The ship approached the horizon and yet the horizon seemed to drift further and further way."

Name: Watchful Eye
Description: "With enough practice, you can teach yourself to see things others cannot."

Name: Baroness
Description: "As his troops were routed, he told me my place was at Court. I put an arrow through his eye."

Name: Blighted Recurve
Description: "This bow stinks!"

Name: Cure for Rebirth
Description: "Did you resurrect once more? An arrow to the head will fix that!"

Name: Dragonfang Recurve
Description: "This bow weighs more than others of its kind, perhaps because of the beings it was used to slay before your time."

Name: Dryad's Chosen Bow
Description: "A unique bow, this belonged to one of the first Dryad Rangers."

Name: Foresight of the Elders
Description: "They knew that their enemies would one day come for them. And so they prepared, forging weapons with which to defend themselves."

Name: Forgotten Ranger's Recurve
Description: "The Soulwarden's sent her out into the corrupted frontier on a simple scouting mission. Her bow was found weeks later, but she never materialized."

Name: Gravewatcher
Description: "Keep an eye on what rises from below."

Name: Herald of the Storm
Description: "When they see the first arrow descend upon them, they shall know that we have arrived."

Name: Luminous Longbow
Description: "The crystals adorning the limbs shine bright even on the darkest of nights."

Name: Master Ranger's Maplewood Recurve
Description: "Initiation into the order of master rangers was no small feat. Once the trials were completed, you were charged to craft your own Bow from maplewood."

Name: Miserable Guard's Bow
Description: "He sought to be an adventurer, but an arrow to the knee forced him into mere guard duty."

Name: Moment of Clarity
Description: "You will consider these things I have told you for a long time. One day you will come to understand."

Name: On Wings of Song
Description: "Fly free, far, and true. Let these notes carry you."

Name: Overgrowth
Description: "The wilds overran the village, forcing the people from their homes. Decades of history, uprooted in an instance."

Name: Pacifist
Description: "I do not wish to harm you. Step away so that no one must be hurt."

Name: Patient Judgement
Description: "What makes the corrupted rangers truly elite is not that they know when to loose their arrow. It's that they know when to not loose it."

Name: Resistance of the Guardians
Description: "Not all of Aeternum was accepting of the Guardian's presence. They were forced to fight tooth and nail to defend their place in this world."

Name: Ruined Hopes
Description: "The sea took everything from me, why should I not take everything from you?"

Name: Secret Atrocity
Description: "What new terrible knowledge will we uncover with these new insights?"

Name: Sundershot
Description: "Tear open the seams of reality."

Name: Sylvan Grace
Description: "She has the footwork of a sylph and the fangs of a snake, true to her family line."

Name: The Lookout
Description: "There, do you see it! It looks like a living tree!"

Name: Longsight
Description: "They say she has the eyes of a sylph, but I think she's just lucky."

Name: Veilpiercer
Description: "Look beyond what is in front of you. See the evil beyond the pale."

Name: Warpwood
Description: "The wood is unlike anything you've seen before, twisted by some wild magic."

Name: Anchor's Mark
Description: "X marks the spot."

Name: Angel's Wings
Description: "I pray that they shall guide my arrow."

Name: Arcane Sight
Description: "The watchful eye of the Guardians sees beyond time."

Name: Athena's Charge
Description: "As fierce a warrior as Athena was, her skill with a bow was nearly umatched."

Name: Blind Justice
Description: "With a blind fold over my eyes I shall let fate decide who lives and who dies."

Name: Bloodboiled Longbow
Description: "A dark maroon coat of "paint" lingers on the treated wood limbs."

Name: Bloodpiercer
Description: "Dull arrows won't kill you nearly as fast as a razor sharp arrow would. Rather, you'll lay in agony as the blood slowly departs your body."

Name: Bow of Arcane Sacrifice
Description: "A wizard's test subject met his fate when his soul was absorbed into the strings of this bow. When an arrow is drawn, his screams of pain can still be heard."

Name: Bow of Dark Rebirth
Description: “Forget what you had before. Let the dark tendrils of corruption give you life anew.”

Name: Bow of Good Fortune
Description: "How lucky are you to have been shipwrecked on such a peaceful and quiet island."

Name: Bow of the Crystal Palace
Description: "For decades a king ruled from a palace carved of crystal. His hopes and dreams shattered as his palace crumbled around him, forever entombing him."

Name: Bow of the Woods Demon
Description: "Spriggans are bastardly beings. Not quite the friendly natural spirits you might be used to."

Name: Comet's Light
Description: "As you launch your arrow into the night sky, a steady light sits in its trail lighting your way."

Name: Constellation's Guide
Description: "The stars are a vital part of our life. They guide us along our path, holding mysteries we do not yet understand."

Name: Crestborne
Description: "As the waves endure endlessly, so shall you endure on Aeternum."

Name: Crow's Eye Bow
Description: “The pirate king called himself the Crow's Eye. Over the decades he spent sailing the seas he amassed a small armada, and with that armada, a massive fortune.”

Name: Dark Heart
Description: "What do the depths of your heart desire?"

Name: Dragon's Breath Bow
Description: "Few gaze into the maw of the dragon and live to tell the tale."

Name: Dreamseeker
Description: "Let my arrow bring you to a deep, dreamfilled sleep."

Name: End of Tyranny
Description: "Despots rule only so long as their people are unable to rise up."

Name: Eternal Suffering
Description: "Even death fails to bring solace."

Name: Fates Design
Description: "As you draw the bowstring taught, the threads of reality splay before you. Which fate do you choose?"

Name: Ferocity of the Impaler
Description: "A bow formed from corrupted matter. Its arrows impale pure corrupted essence into the wielder's enemies."

Name: Ferret's Firey Longbow
Description: "You'd think that a flaming bow would be an inefficient way to hunt a creature as small as a feret... And you'd be right!"

Name: Fleshbinder's Recurve
Description: "When my arrow tastes your blood, you shall be bound to me."

Name: Forced Heir
Description: "Being fourth in line for the throne means you will likely never wear the crown. Taking the line of succession into your own hands yields more consistent results."

Name: Herald's Signal Fire
Description: The power is almost worth the stench of death and excrement that lingers on this ogre's bow.

Name: Forked Tongue
Description: "Watch her words, for while they may ring true there is always a cost to them."

Name: Frost Bite
Description: "Posessed by a vengeful frozen giest, this bow yearns to make others suffer as it had."

Name: Gilded Recurve
Description: "Solid gold limbs and bright shining jewels make this a bow fit for a Queen."

Name: Hailstorm
Description: "The frozen arrows crashed and shattered upon the battlements as they fled in terror."

Name: Heart of the Greenwoods
Description: "What dies shall be regrown."

Name: Heartseeker
Description: "Lead the wind and watch as it carries your arrow to its mark."

Name: Herald's Signal Fire
Description: "Once the signal fires have been lit, all the hosts loyal to Mozrul the Herald will come to his aid, and nothing shall stand in his way."

Name: Lone Tracker's Bow
Description: "Hunting a Wood Elk through Edengrove is no easy business."

Name: Longbow of the Earthmother
Description: "Her rangers stand ready to defend her from all who may seek to harm the earth."

Name: Longbow of the Rainbow Legion
Description: "Rumors swirled Aeternum, tales of an army of rangers wielding bows adorned with every manner of gem."

Name: Longbow of the Starstone Barrows
Description: "Whatever force destroyed the obelisk imbued this bow with some source of magical energy."

Name: Miradath, the Corrupted Vision
Description: "Come, see the world as I see it. Let us forge it anew."

Name: Mourning Light
Description: “Do not shed tears for me, I shall return by dawn.”

Name: Nature's Truth
Description: "Nature cares not for your morals."

Name: Osilius, Longbow of the Exiled Archmage
Description: "Many mages preferred staves or gauntlets. Yet Rowan the Exile preferred to cast his spells by using a bow as his conduit."

Name: Patience
Description: "Deep breaths. In...out. In...out. In...draw. Out...loose."

Name: Precision
Description: "Your arrow always finds its mark."

Name: Recurve of the Dark Gods
Description: "Dark forces permeate the bow, forces with ancient origins that we still do not quite understand."

Name: Ruby Recurve
Description: "A bright red ruby sits on both limbs of this longbow. When it catches the light just right, it is more beautiful than anything you have ever seen."

Name: Shadow of the Moon
Description: "Night falls and dark creatures stir, eager to avoid the burning tendrils of sunlight."

Name: Silent Demise
Description: "The arrows glisten in the moonlit sky yet they make not a sound."

Name: Slayer's Crossbow
Description: "Every shot is an exercise of economy. No movement is wasted in pursuit of its prey."

Name: Sorrow's Cry
Description: "When the lights go out in their eyes and you hear the cries of their loved ones, you shall know I was there."

Name: Soulthief
Description: "The arrow pieces your flesh and rips your soul from its cage."

Name: Steadylimb
Description: "A sense of calm washes over you as you grip the bow. Patience is your ally, use it to loose the perfect shot."

Name: Stormcursed Bow
Description: "Struck by lightning while being creating this bow, the original owner was shocked as he fell into the ocean, falling to the depths of the sea."

Name: Swashbuckler's Trueshot
Description: "When you see the Jolly Roger on the horizon, it will be too late."

Name: Swift Approach
Description: "Swift action can often turn the tide in battle. And a fast approach can catch your foes off guard."

Name: Terror of the Seas
Description: "Blackbeard's sigil was enough to make ships flee. But once other ships were in range of his arrows, they had no hope of surviving."

Name: The Demon Lord's Bow
Description: "Ripped from the corpse of a fallen entity, the power this bow exudes overwhelm's you."

Name: Titanic Intent
Description: "The Ancients seem to have been fixated on one goal, and nothing was going to interrupt their mission... until corruption happened."

Name: Truestrike
Description: "May my aim be true, even in the face of eternity."

Name: Warforged Compact Battlebow
Description: "Well crafted, lightweight, and easy to grip. This bow is perfect for the chaos that descends upon a battlefield."

Name: Western Wind
Description: "These frigid gales bring us nothing but lightning and misery."

Name: Widow's Kiss
Description: "No one heard his web-muffled scream as the Gravewidow decended upon him."

Name: Bear Fur Recurve
Description: "Bear fur has quite the grip, making it a perfect cover for the limbs of a bow."

Name: Coda
Description: All tales deserve a proper conclusion.

Name: Warden's Answer
Description: A pointed response to an impertinent question.

Name: Fangs of Setcheh
Description: Strike as the serpent does.

Name: Fleabite
Description: Its bite is more annoying than painful.

Name: Slayer of Skies
Description: "Reach back, bear the Sky, and destroy the distant one."

Name: Minor Thunderbolt
Description: A small token of Juipter's favor.

Name: Rootwrapped Axe
Description: "Roots envelop the handle, providing you with a formidable grip."

Name: Sapling's Fury
Description: "While small in stature, this axe is capable of considerable damage."

Name: Bloodshot Reaver
Description: "The town bells rang as the barbarians descended upon the village, ready to plunder and pillage."

Name: Hatchet of the Enchanted Woods
Description: "Legends say this axe once belonged to a great Elf woodsman. But of course, those are just legends..."

Name: Arbirator's Wisdom
Description: "The difference between life and death is but a swing."

Name: Aristocrat's Fine Hatchet
Description: "While the high born rarely do phyiscal labor, they do enjoy tossing the occasional axe at a stuffed target."

Name: Berserker's Bane
Description: "For all his ferocity, it was his own axe that doomed him."

Name: Brittle Fury
Description: “Great for hacking at flesh, quite terrible at culling trees.”

Name: Ceremonial Cleaver
Description: "Syndicate archaeologists suspect this axe was used for Ancient rituals. What those rituals were is still unknown."

Name: Dark Quandary
Description: "If your opponent falls in a forest, and no one is around to hear it, did they really die?"

Name: Desecrated Logger
Description: "Honest work won't save you from the darkest calling."

Name: Dragonsblood
Description: "Let this token remind you of your history. You are one of us."

Name: Howling Wind
Description: "A sound like the cry of a wolf can be heard when this axe is thrown."

Name: Jagged Amethyst Cleaver
Description: "The beauty and the brutality of this weapon are not lost on you."

Name: Kent's Grave Trowel
Description: "Technically the bodies don't decompose, but the Azoth residue is quite healthy for the gravebloom."

Name: Mountineer's Remorse
Description: "While being frozen solid can make hatchets more effective, this generally isn't true of their climbers."

Name: Panacea's Touch
Description: "As you grip the handle you feel your ailments begin to fade."

Name: Port of Call
Description: "He wouldn't leave the vessel until he was home. He did not seek the wonders of the world.“

Name: Smoldering Rage
Description: "The hatchet is dormant until it feels the firm grip of a hand. Once wielded, it sets itself ablaze."

Name: Zephyr Strike
Description: "Flies true, even in the harshest winds."

Name: Scapula
Description: He won't be needing this anymore, right?

Name: Matthias's Gravedigger
Description: “He put them in the ground before he brought them back.”

Name: Charblade
Description: "Dipped in the fiery heart of Vesuvius."

Name: Neverending Winter
Description: "I remember the day clearly. It was a joyous day, a day of celebration. And the next day, the sun did not rise, nor would it again."

Name: Crow's Nest
Description: "The lookout was the first to set her eyes on the mythical island. After months battling the waves at sea, the crew would now turn their eyes towards a new foe."

Name: Calcified Cleaver
Description: "Eons of sediment has built up to hide the true nature of this axe. What remains is a razor sharpe edge that is sure to leave an infection alongside a wound."

Name: Jawbreaker
Description: "Nothing says 'stop talking' like a hatchet to the jaw."

Name: Corrupted Remnant
Description: "After the breach closed, this axe is all that remained. The corruption upon it appears to sing as you wield it."

Name: Semblance of Order
Description: "Once we have what we need, calm everyone down. Then, fire the building."

Name: Sinewslicer
Description: "Tearing limb from limb is not an easy task without this axe."

Name: Haunted Hacker
Description: "Forged in a soulfire smithy, the axe holds a shard of the smith's tormented soul."

Name: Ancient Tactics
Description: "Slashing at a hamstring is far more effective than slashing at an arm. If your enemy cannot move, they cannot fight."

Name: Artisan's Axe
Description: "This weapon was the mangum opus of a great smith who resided in Windsward."

Name: Ashen Victory
Description: "When the pillaging was over, the bandit's axe was covered in ash and blood."

Name: Axe of the Elder Gods
Description: "The first humans thought the Ancients to be gods. They forged weapons and armor in the name of their new deities."

Name: Fearreaver
Description: "Let not the timid wield me."

Name: Gaia's Justice
Description: “When the Angry Earth arose from the depths of Aeternum, they brought with them ferocious weapons of imbued wood.”

Name: Horrific Beauty
Description: “For all of the evil wrought upon the world by the Corrupted, there's a certain beauty in the chaos.”

Name: Restless Sanctity
Description: "We think we can speak of sacred things as though they are not, and we will pay dearly for it."

Name: Silent Killer
Description: "When you least expect it. Boom."

Name: Soulwalker's Limbcarver
Description: "You suddenly have one less question about all those Withered walking around with only one arm."

Name: Trustworthy Knave
Description: "A thief you can trust is no thief to you."

Name: Wishmaker
Description: "If you want to make your wishes come true, seize the moment. Seize your destiny."

Name: Stinky's Hatchet
Description: This weapon was used to single handedly drive an army of boars out of Weaver's Fen.

Name: Cardinal Sin
Description: "When the Ancients first awoke the Azoth, they brought forth a power they could not understand."

Name: Contingency Plan
Description: "As far as plans go, this wasn't the worst. It wasn't the best, either."

Name: Ironjaw's Bite
Description: "As sharp as Ironjaw's teeth, it strikes as fast as Ironjaw's bite."

Name: From On High
Description: "The hatchet glows with an otherworldly iridescence."

Name: Sandscribe
Description: "The sands shall sing your story when they are coated in your blood."

Name: Time-Lost Slicer
Description: "This axe looks decades ahead of its time, far too advanced to have been crafted by any human."

Name: Archmage's Assistant
Description: "The mages historically have favored staves and enchanted gauntlets. But some problems require a bit more force."

Name: Axe of Violence
Description: "For those who think violence is the answer, this axe is their ultimate goal."

Name: Toothed Bite
Description: "Teeth gleaming from between the trees. To blink is to be dead."

Name: Deal with the Devil
Description: "Forged in Hell itself, this axe promises immense power at the price of one's soul."

Name: Hatchet of the First Scout
Description: "The elite guardian scouts kept their city safe for generations, forewarning of any impending assault by enemy forces."

Name: Censure
Description: "For your punishment you shall receive three strikes of my hatchet. Should you survive, you shall receive three more."

Name: Newfound Hope
Description: "We sailed across the sea looking for a better life. We never thought we'd end up stuck here."

Name: Crystal Carver
Description: "Pickaxes are so old school. Just slash off a chunk of a rock with your axe!"

Name: Adjucator of Pain
Description: "Who shall my axe strike? Why must I choose but one of you."

Name: A Trick of the Mind
Description: "Watch more closely now, for if you blink, you will miss it."

Name: Bannerman's Bane
Description: "Loyalty to the wrong house is such a petty reason to lay down your life."

Name: Bilelash
Description: "A never ending stream of poison oozes from the head of the hatchet."

Name: Bloodletter
Description: "One swing from this and your humours will settle."

Name: Breaching Hatchet
Description: "Into the breach I shall go. Waht awaits me on the other side, I do not know."

Name: Buccaneer's Bulwark
Description: "Traditionally footsoldiers have used a shield. But to defend themselvs, the greatest pirates would wield only axes."

Name: Concubine
Description: "While I love my wife and my children, my hatchet is my one true love."

Name: Dreamhacker
Description: "I live more in my dreams than I do in my life."

Name: Dunweald
Description: "There are many places that remain sacred to the Dryads. Defending these holy sites is of the utmost importance to them."

Name: Dynasty's Demise
Description: "The vision of the Empress must be fulfilled, no matter the cost."

Name: Eunuch's Savior
Description: "This is a tough world for a eunuch. One must carry a weapon to defend oneself."

Name: Freshforged Edge
Description: "This axe is newly crafted from the forges of Everfall. A fine finish and a razor sharp edge makes this formidable against any foe."

Name: Frostfang
Description: "The biting cold is surely the worst way to die."

Name: Humming Hatchet
Description: "The corruption hums within the weapon, a low eerie vibration that never ceases to stop."

Name: Prideful Misstep
Description: "Everyone watched as he walked unknowingly into his own demise."

Name: Restless Reaver
Description: "Death does not sleep. Death does not rest."

Name: Righteous Fury
Description: "Heretic! Liar! Your life is forfeit!"

Name: Sea Foam
Description: "I had never seen the foam of the ocean be red before, until the battle at the Stolen Shores."

Name: Smoldering Ember
Description: "On a dark moonless night, let my fire guide your way."

Name: Untold Secrets
Description: "They told you what they wanted you to hear."

Name: Velian
Description: "The inherent viciousness of the axe is palpable when looking at it. This weapon was created by an angry, angry man."

Name: Watcher's Right Hand
Description: "So anyway, I sent them into a cave to get that swill you like to drink. I'm surpised they made it back."

Name: Rufus' Throwstick
Description: "I threw my axe across the ground. He brought it back. My loyal hound."

Name: Feast of Blood
Description:
Geri and Freki
the war-wont sates,
the triumphant sire of hosts;
but on wine only
the famed in arms,
Odin, ever lives.

Name: Fleshwrapped Hatchet
Description: “The handle is clearly wrapped in human flesh. The tension on the flesh makes you think it may not be that old...”

Name: Cauterizing Hatchet
Description: "It's not sterile, and it just may kill you. But in a pinch this hatchet will close any wound that it already opened."

Name: Best Wishes
Description: "Sometimes the things we're looking for show up when we least expect it."

Name: Maker's Mark
Description: "As he put the finishing touches on the blade he knew his mark was out there, waiting to be hunted."

Name: Pixie's Punisher
Description: "Tiny, nasty creatures, Pixies wield enchanted weapons that any creature should be frightened by."

Name: Axe of the Abyss
Description: "Many souls are lost as they try to harness the power of Corruption. To do so is to lose oneself."

Name: Alakazham's Incantation
Description: "The mythical wizard was said to have blessed this Hatchet with his power before bestowing it on a brave Ranger."

Name: Alphabane
Description: "Pure skill."

Name: Blood and Flesh
Description: "Look no further if you hunger for the sight of blood. With this in hand you shall feast your eyes."

Name: Avarice
Description: "Look upon others and want not. Or do. No one can stop you."

Name: Balanos's Crystal Battleaxe
Description: "The great shaman Balanos was gifted a Hatchet when he overtook control of the Lush Hideaway."

Name: Beyond Reason
Description: "Abominations such as this really prove the point of 'Just because you can, doesn't mean you should.'"

Name: Bonechopper
Description: "The first living thing I killed was a chicken. I was about six or so. My dad gave me his handaxe and told me to get started on dinner."

Name: Brittle Bones
Description: “A hatchet made from the bones of fallen enemies. Clearly these enemies were weak as bits and pieces of the hatchet break off with each swing.”

Name: Buccaneer's Bounty
Description: "When the pirates sacked the great coastal cities, a buccaneer was particularly enticed by this axe. They brought it with them, and in their misfortune it washed ashore in Aeternum."

Name: Chillwind Hatchet
Description: "The cold blast of wind chilled the warrior to the bone, freezing her in her place."

Name: Ciradul, the Lazarine Warden
Description: "The Lazarus pits are sacred to the Dryads. To defile them is sacrilege."

Name: Clean Conscious
Description: "Killing never bothered me anyway."

Name: Cobra-headed Hatchet
Description: "Strike first. Strike hard. No mercy."

Name: Conquest
Description: "We are constantly at war with the forces of the island, and yet we still find time to war against one another."

Name: Corpsebride's Cleaver
Description: "On the day of her wedding she sliced off her husband's hands so that he could never grasp another woman again."

Name: Corrupted Chopper
Description: "The pursuit of power has led many to tamper with forces they do not fully understand."

Name: Crawler's Cleaver
Description: "Crawling through the caverns beneath Aeternum is not for the faint of heart. Carry a big torch and a sharp edge to ward off whatever you might find."

Name: Cultist's Cleaver
Description: "Dozens of hooded figures appeared in the Brightwood's mist, each of them wielding a starmetal hatchet."

Name: Daedalus
Description: "Fly to close to the sun and your wings shall be scorched."

Name: Dark Widow
Description: "The hooded figure appeared as if out of nowhere. They raised their axe and struck silently and viciously. Dark magic poured from the wound and flowed towards the axe."

Name: Desecrated Ceremonial Hatchet
Description: “The sacred runes on the side of the hatchet have been defiled by blight.”

Name: Diamondhead
Description: "Pure diamond encases the edge of the hatchet, sharpened to the finest point you have ever seen."

Name: Doom's Edge
Description: "Death is far closer than any of us realize."

Name: Eviscerator
Description: "It's famously difficult to bisect a person. Unless of course you have this."

Name: Fiendish Slicer
Description: "This battlescarred piece of steel is coated in layers of blood that no one has attempted to clean."

Name: Foulmouth
Description: "Speak the words of power and receive my gift."

Name: Fury
Description: "You will know it not only by name, but by taste, smell, and the relief it brings."

Name: Gortan's Fall
Description: "'Yes,' he hissed in Gortan's ear. 'Dragons.'"

Name: Graverobber
Description: "Stealing from the dead is risky business."

Name: Greater Purpose
Description: "Where does mankind come from? You shall find out."

Name: Greenkeeper's Axe
Description: "Mythical figures to most, the Dryad Greenkeepers were fierce defenders of Aeternum's land."

Name: Hatchet of the Arcane Tower
Description: "The mages buried their noses in books while the world around them changed. But their research led to an enchanted hatchet capable of great destruction."

Name: Hatchet of the Corrupted Frontier
Description: "The Corrupted continously push south, seeking to corrupt all in their path and expand their reach."

Name: High Priest's Ceremonial Hatchet
Description: "The high priest kept a hatchet next to his altar, using it for a wide variety of ceremonies and sacrifices. Little did he know he would one day become the sacrifice."

Name: Honorsbane
Description: "Honorable people rarely live long."

Name: Horrific Slasher
Description: "The original owner of this axe was responsibile for the death of a cabin full of people prior to his disappearance."

Name: Hulking Hatchet
Description: "Far too large to truly be an effective throwing axe, but just too small to qualify as a battle axe."

Name: Imbued Hatchet
Description: "Raw magical energy courses through the hatchet, empowering each and every swing."

Name: Lazarine Cleaver
Description: "The weapons found in the vaults of the Lazarus Pits seem to inherit some of their former master's energy."

Name: Legacy
Description: Legacy Hatchet

Name: Magma
Description: "Molten lava spews from the head of the hatchet, dripping to the floor below it."

Name: Malthazar's Lost Hatchet
Description: "An inscription on the handle of the hatchet leads you to believe that this weapon was once possessed by the great corrupted champion Malthazar. How it ended up in your hands is something of a mystery."

Name: Mammoth's Tusk
Description: "The ivory of the mammoth makes for a lightweight and durable hatchet, perfect for carving up your enemies."

Name: Muttering Madness
Description: "They speak to themselves not for comfort, but because they are trying to understand some grand design only they can see."

Name: Nightweaver
Description: "The magical energies of Aeternum sing a different song at night. Nightweaver seems to shine a bit brighter when the sun goes down."

Name: Nyhart's Hatchet
Description: "The great freebooter Nyhart is most famous for their anchorage, but tales of their deadly hatchet still haunt the seven seas."

Name: Obsidian Reaver
Description: "Volcanic in nature, this hatchet's detail is as fine as any."

Name: Ona'thul
Description: "Blessed hatchet of the Corrupted priests."

Name: Orion's Road
Description: "Hold your axe to the sky and let the stars be your guide."

Name: Remnant of Before
Description: "Things weren't always like this. Life used to be easy, peaceful. Now we must fight each day to survive."

Name: Revenge of the Fallen
Description: "As the berserker watched his commrades fall on the battlefield, he was filled with a great rage. His bloodlust would be sated only with the blood of his enemies."

Name: Scorpio Slasher
Description: "From what we can deduce, Scorpio was a sacred place to the Ancients warriors, and their Guardians still linger around the ruins."

Name: Shattered Dreams
Description: "It's just a piece of stained glass strapped to a stick, and yet it is surprisingly deadly."

Name: Shatterspike
Description: "Massive thorns line the blade of the hatchet."

Name: Silent Cry
Description: "Then pain you experience is so intense that your mouth opens, but nothing comes out."

Name: Spriggan's Claw
Description: "The Spriggans are horrible creatures that wreak havoc on even the toughest armor. Their razor sharp claws can slice through anything."

Name: Storm's Edge
Description: "Batten the hatches and buckle down the ship. When the storm comes its fury follows."

Name: Tailchopper
Description: “All it takes is a sharp axe and a strong swipe.”

Name: The Butcher's Cleaver
Description: "The horror's this axe has wrought upon humanity..."

Name: The Confidant
Description: "A good axe never misses, and certainly never tells."

Name: The Quartermaster
Description: "Hungry sailors often try to sneak into the stores for an extra biscuit. But the risk of losing a hand was deterence enough for most."

Name: Timewarped Axe
Description: "This axe is both brand new and ancient all at once, a byproduct of some Ancient magics."

Name: Tundra's Call
Description: "Most rangers avoid the tundra. But the few who brave it have found weapons and riches beyond their wildest dreams."

Name: Ultimate Clarity
Description: "Through this lense, you'll see what is really important in life."

Name: Violent Delight
Description: "These tend to have violent ends."

Name: Virulent Edge
Description: "The axe itself seems to be diseased, cursed to infect all who may be struck by it."

Name: Wavebound Hatchet
Description: "The smith plunged the hatchet into the icey ocean water while the metal was still molten. Steam seeped above the waves as the ocean cooled the metal. This weapon was borne in the ocean, and it would forever be tied to it."

Name: Werewolf Hunter
Description: "Sightings of Werewolves have been reported for years in Aeternum, but one has never actually been hunted and killed."

Name: Wild Ambition
Description: "When you relentlessly pursue one road, you tend to miss the forks."

Name: Zealous Hatchet
Description: "A desire to do harm possesses the wielder."

Name: Tiger's Instinct
Description: “Glad I had a friend watching my back when that beast ambushed me from behind.”

Name: Natural Order
Description: "The berserker stalked the wilds, defending the land and defeating any who may seek to descrate her forest."

Name: Satet's Key
Description: It opens far more than just doors.

Name: Anuket's Key
Description: Flows like a waterfall, flooding your foes.

Name: Cactus Carver
Description: Able to cut through all obstacles while avoiding any annoying thorns.

Name: Mihos' Paw
Description: The swipe of a lion paw knocks down all foes.

Name: Floodwater's Gift
Description: Crafted from the silt of the Nile.

Name: Spark of Dual Divinity
Description: Why worship one god when you could have two?

Name: Wanderer's Fire Staff
Description: "Speak softly and carry a big flaming stick."

Name: Searing Pain
Description: "If you can't take the heat, don't stand in its path."

Name: Sparklight
Description: "Your legacy is like a spark. Light it and watch it grow."

Name: Soultorch
Description: "Ignite the soul."

Name: Ancient Firebrand
Description: "The Ancients briefly experimented with fire magic when they arrived, though they largely found it too primitive for their tastes."

Name: Arcane Fire
Description: "Master magicians all start somewhere. The poor soul who lost this is probably still being scolded."

Name: Burning Faestaff
Description: "The staff is clearly crafted by the faefolk, with an enchanted flame adorning the edges."

Name: Burning Voidtendril
Description: "The void burns all that it touches as it corrupts the weak of heart."

Name: Cinder
Description: "Know that, in this moment, you and the fire are as one."

Name: Firestorm Spellstaff
Description: "Without notice the sky opened up and fire began raining down from the heavens."

Name: Flame of the Wilds
Description: "Fires are a natural occurence. They uproot the old and bring in the new."

Name: Frostbitten Fire Staff
Description: “The flame lingers despite the frosty tendrils of the staff.”

Name: Gravekeeper's Torch
Description: "Keep watch over the dead, for they are restless and dangerous."

Name: Ignited Greatstaff
Description: "Keep your rage in check lest it consume your being."

Name: Love, Ignited
Description: "Look at me, tell me that what I am feeling is not real."

Name: Mariner's Flaming Greatstaff
Description: "Before crash landing on Aeternum most sailors thought that magic was just a myth. They never could have imagined they'd one day wield such a power."

Name: Shining Light
Description: "Let the world see your light."

Name: Spellstaff of the Dark Magician
Description: "Wield this magic wisely. With great power comes a great cost."

Name: Staff of the Fragile Flame
Description: "Stoke the flame lest it die a quiet death."

Name: Unbridled Fury
Description: "The enemy of my enemy is my enemy."

Name: Flamebraiser
Description: "Cooked to perfection."

Name: Channeler's Fire Staff
Description: Channeler's Fire Staff

Name: Flaming Branch
Description: "A massive branch with an everburning flame affixed to the end."

Name: Voidburned Spellstaff
Description: "The voidfire has left this weapon scarred and hurting."

Name: Staff of the Boiling Bog
Description: "The flaming waters of the bog burn with an unrelenting fury."

Name: Madman's Spellstaff
Description: "Fire for everyone!"

Name: Purest Intentions
Description: "Step forward and take up the staff. Your will is its power. Your desires will manifest in the purest flame."

Name: Massive Matchstick
Description: "Lighting a fire has never been easier."

Name: Eye of the Inferno
Description: "The eye plucked from a great lion makes an excellent focus for fire."

Name: Joan's Soulfire Torch
Description: "The undead huntress lit aflame her torch as she sought to gather more souls for the taking."

Name: Breach Hunter's Fire Staff
Description: "Find the breaches into this world and close them."

Name: Pillar of Brightwood
Description: "People often wonder what makes Brightwood bright. This is part of the answer."

Name: Breath of Sekhmet
Description: "Like an inferno, when she opened her mouth to speak, the world burned with each word."

Name: Flaming Fire Staff
Description: "The fire seems to be caught on fire. Odd."

Name: Guardian's Imbued Fire Staff
Description: "Charged by the Ancients to keep watch over their creations, the Guardians have employed a number of methods to safeguard their secrets."

Name: Ashen Wake
Description: "To ash with them. They will burn here and in the afterlife."

Name: Bleak Fire Staff
Description: "There is no hope here."

Name: Crystallight Staff
Description: "An unwavering glow shines forth from the staff."

Name: Dark Light
Description: "A peculiar staff that seems to emit darkness rather than light."

Name: Explosive Fire Staff
Description: "The perfect weapon for giving yourself an explosive edge in battle."

Name: Fiery Beauty
Description: "This staff is pretty, but nothing compares to the elegance of a dancing flame."

Name: Firebrand
Description: "She walked among the flames unburned. It was as though they embraced her."

Name: Flamewhisper
Description: "The subtlest spark can grow into the most powerful fire."

Name: Gravedigger's Torch
Description: "Light the dark as you bury your friends."

Name: Snowflame Staff
Description: "The beautiful duality of fire and frost leaves little to be desired."

Name: Staff of the Fiery Sacrifice
Description: "Burn the lamb and receive my blessing."

Name: Tomblight
Description: "I caution you; do not so eagerly go seeking what might lie in the depths."

Name: Winter Star
Description: "Only the strangest magicks can meld fire and ice together."

Name: Steambinding Staff
Description: "Steam burns all the same as fire."

Name: Black Fire
Description: "The dark fire coven is a collective of some of Aeternum's most powerful pyromancers. To wield the black flame is to know true power."

Name: Blistering Heat
Description: The handle gets a little too warm when you cast a lot of spells in a row with this staff.

Name: Eruption
Description: "My rage boils within me. Do not tempt me to let it loose."

Name: Archeologean's Lantern
Description: "To illuminate the past, you need a lantern with the power to shine through the ages."

Name: Ceremonial Darkstaff
Description: "A runic shaft coated with dark ash, this weapon is hauntingly beautiful."

Name: First Flame
Description: "When humans discovered fire, the course of history was changed."

Name: Falmea's Wrath
Description: A warm presence emanates from this staff, hoping her strength is worthy of the one whom wields her.

Name: Executioner's Burden
Description: "Know that I take no joy in ending your life."

Name: Staff of the Lost Shore
Description: "The ship was lost at sea for months, choked by a dense fog until a light shone through and guided their way."

Name: Magma Core Staff
Description: "The molten fire drips from the staff leaving fire in its wake."

Name: Insatiable Want
Description: "The longing you feel for one another will be seared upon the world."

Name: Acolyte's Corrupted Fire Staff
Description: "Corrupted acolytes wield a number of powerful magics. Their staves serve as conduits for their limitless power."

Name: A Terrible Thought
Description: "I spoke my mind and they recoiled in horror. Then, one by one, they agreed."

Name: Baric's Sunstaff
Description: "The light and power of the sun are yours to control."

Name: Blood Boiling Fire Staff
Description: "A slow death is much worse than a quick death."

Name: Breachfire Greatstaff
Description: "Control the flames of the breach so that your allies do not get burned."

Name: Cannonlighter
Description: "Light the fuse and let our enemies feel our wrath!"

Name: Choking Gasp
Description: "Smoke is a temperamental thing, always wafting this way and that. Learn to control it, and you can control the battlefield."

Name: Dragon's Breath
Description: Dragon's Breath

Name: Funeral Pyre
Description: "Most people think a cremation takes a lot of wood. With this it just takes time."

Name: Grove Keeper's Fire Staff
Description: "Sometimes the forest must burn so that life can begin anew."

Name: Heatseeker
Description: "Find the flame and light it."

Name: Immolation
Description: “Set your enemies on fire. Watch them burn.”

Name: Light of Corruption
