Description: "Why must we fight? Let us talk!"

Name: Swan Song
Description: "This is your finale."

Name: Tour de Pain
Description: "Oh how much you can truly hurt."

Name: Troubador
Description: "Come, sing us a song."

Name: Veronica's Justice
Description: "Whatever sort of justice the world had, she had other ideas."

Name: Wartorn Rapier
Description: "This rapier has seen endless conflict."

Name: Watcher's Dutybound Rapier
Description: "The oath you swore means you will stand guard for all time, greeting newcomers to this land and defending us from whatever horrors wash ashore."

Name: Wavepiercer
Description: "Crash through the waves. Endure, and come out the other side."

Name: Wedding Tribute
Description: "This weapon was a gift for the bride to be. Instead it would be her undoing."

Name: Weightless Sabre
Description: "So light it is as if you are holding nothing at all."

Name: When They Come
Description: "The day all settlements fear is when the corrupted show up at your doorstep."

Name: When They Come
Description: "The day all settlements fear is when the corrupted show up at your doorstep."

Name: Entrée
Description: Its many wielders believed battle to be a graceful dance.

Name: Hunter's Claw
Description: "Rend its flesh and retreat to safety. Let it wear itself out."

Name: Aristocrat's Calling
Description: The weapon of a refined duelist.

Name: Mange
Description: Maybe...maybe don't touch this one...

Name: Harrow's Pincer
Description: It sweeps across the ground like rays of light from the sun.

Name: Revenge of the Scorned
Description: Love and hate are two sides of the same coin.

Name: Appointed Negotiator
Description: "Karl never gave orders without having his Appointed Negotiator around. It never failed to stop arguments before they started."

Name: Dryad Walking Stick
Description: "Useful for climbing steep hills or fending off unwanted companions."

Name: Pigsticker
Description: "Perfect for hunting boar and roasting them afterwards."

Name: Olcott Cutter
Description: "Originally used for hunting animals, over time it became something that struck fear into the hearts of people and animals alike."

Name: Forthright
Description: "Direct and to the point. Take this path to victory."

Name: Captain's Call
Description: "All hands on deck!"

Name: Corrupted Skewer
Description: "The corrupted do not treat us as humans. They see us only as pigs to be slaughtered."

Name: Diamond's Head
Description: "The head of a spear is an odd use for such a precious gem, though I suppose it is rather sharp."

Name: Faefolk's Spear
Description: "Beautiful flowers and vines adorn every corner of this weapon. It is as enchanting as it is deadly."

Name: Forest's Guide
Description: "Keep the Dryads at an arms reach, for they are lethal creatures."

Name: Gutskewer
Description: "The executioner jammed the spear into his prisoner's abdomen, ripping out his entrails."

Name: Icepick
Description: "The glacial freeze is difficult to break up. In my years of exploration I've found that quick and powerful jabs yield the most consistent results."

Name: Jagged Edged Javelin
Description: "Hooks adorn the edge of the spear's head, allowing it to remain stuck inside any victim."

Name: Journeyman's Practice Lance
Description: "Jousting is an older art, but it still requires years of training before you have any shot of competing in a tournament."

Name: Lightning Rod
Description: "In the heart of a storm, lightning seems drawn to this weapon."

Name: Long Arm of the Law
Description: "You cannot outrun justice."

Name: Misery's Cure
Description: "Let me end your anguish."

Name: Oversized "Wand"
Description: "An overconfident mage once tried to teach an ogre to use a wand. The ogre quickly discarded the wand and killed the mage, but what remains seems to be functional as a spear."

Name: Shiny Spear
Description: "It glistens in the light."

Name: Singed Pike
Description: "At one point or another this weapon was thrust into a fire leaving a long charred scar across the shaft."

Name: Vinewrapped Spear
Description: "Overgrowth has replaced a considerable amount of the wood that once formed the shaft of this spear."

Name: Voidtinged Javelin
Description: "Let the tendrils of the void reach into your heart."

Name: Whaler's Harpoon
Description: "Blubber is thick, but my spear is sharp."

Name: Acidic Tip
Description: A little bit of acid goes a long way in softening up a dangerous target.

Name: Shizaru's Sorrow
Description: "As a pirate I visited a thousand evils on my prey. On this forsaken island a thousand deaths I suffered in pennance."

Name: Taskmaster's Motivator
Description: "You don't feel like working? Perhaps a little prod will quicken your pace."

Name: Shizaru's Sorrow
Description: "As a pirate I visited a thousand evils on my prey. On this forsaken island a thousand deaths I suffered in pennance."

Name: Ritualist's Lancet
Description: "Apostate Luca created this spear to lance all impurities out of the world."

Name: Harbinger
Description: "May your first step be a sure sign the battle's end is near."

Name: Brightclaw
Description: "The tip glistens beautifully when it catches the light."

Name: Spread of Malice
Description: "Darkness spreads across the land slowly but steadily, corrupting whatever may be in its path."

Name: Hubris of Holm
Description: "The great Sentinel Holm kept watch over the revered tower Malocchio for generations, and it was the pride of the sentinel that led to the towers stagnation."

Name: The Impaler's Judgement
Description: "Kisare shall decide your fate."

Name: Last Light
Description: "The world changes when the sun dips below the horizon. Things that sleep during the day begin to lurk at night. Carry this weapon with you so that you might see the sun rise again."

Name: Edmand's Fishing Spear
Description: "Perfect for spear fishing against small fish, sharks, and whales. Though maybe don't try to take down a kraken with this."

Name: Seasoned Oak Skewer
Description: "Every jab imparts a unique flavor of pain, carefully procured by Corlew."

Name: Breachforged Spear
Description: "This spear was crafted by dark engineers on the other side of the veil."

Name: Footman's Royal Pike
Description: "A standard issue pike for the royal guard, the craftsmanship of this weapon is immaculate."

Name: Forgotten Virtue
Description: "Do not let this land rip from you who you are."

Name: Fork Lightning
Description: "Lightning cracks from the spear as it is thrown, jutting out in every direction."

Name: Gem Encrusted Pike
Description: "This pike seems more focused on appearing beautiful than it does being an effective weapon."

Name: Javelin of the Corrupted Vanguard
Description: "The vanguard of the corrupted forces are a fearsome lot. When they descend upon an army, none are left alive."

Name: Jungle Guide
Description: "How do you find out what rustles in the brush? Stab it."

Name: Leafwrapped Spear
Description: "The cycle of life binds us all."

Name: Longreach
Description: "Nothing in this life is beyond your grasp."

Name: Mana Conduit
Description: "Flowing with pure magical energy, this spear draws power from the sources around it."

Name: Sharpened Ogre Femur
Description: "Dents and cracks line the bone of this once great beast, yet the tip is sharpened to a fine and lethal point."

Name: Spear of Haunted Memories
Description: "Every time you die in this strange land a piece of you fades away. Die enough times... well, all that remains at that point is the memory of what you once were."

Name: Spear of Volcanic Resolve
Description: "Let the rage course through your veins."

Name: Void Herald
Description: "Pure darkness radiates from the spear, a sort of hunger that thirsts for conquest."

Name: Pike of the Wood Mistress
Description: "She wanders the wilds with a spear at her side, though she dares not draw it unless challenged."

Name: Cutthroat's Javelin
Description: "Give me a name and I shall deliver you a skull."

Name: Envy of Belam
Description: "Many a hunter tried to take down Odious Belam, but only one came close, armed with this spear."

Name: Gnarled Root Spear
Description: "The shaft of this spear is covered in gnarled roots, perfect for the harsh starmetal tip to embed itself in."

Name: Vanguard Ace
Description: "Leadership is not taught or granted, it is demonstrated."

Name: Spear of the Great Hunt
Description: "Ride atop your horse and seek out your prey."

Name: Ceremonial Ranseur of Sacrifice
Description: "Far more than a ceremonial weapon, this ranseur was honed sharp and used often."

Name: Boneshatter's Third Arm
Description: "The ancient Javelineer moved his spear so effortlessly it was like a part of his body."

Name: Javelin of the Corrupted Maiden
Description: "Before she was turned by the power of corruption, she was a warrior of great renown. After she was turned, her visage imbued fear into the hearts of all who had the misfortune to come upon her."

Name: Bloodright
Description: "I never wanted this, and yet I was born to rule. So rule I shall."

Name: Fallen Friend
Description: "I lost most of my crew when I came to Aeternum. But the loss that hurt the most was that of my dear dog. While she came back like all things do here, she was... different."

Name: Javelin of Just Intent
Description: "Weather the storm in your heart and find peace within."

Name: Irreverent Edge
Description: "The tip of the spear is coated with broken shards of glass, creating a mean and vile weapon that seeks to inflict pain more than it seeks to kill."

Name: Violent Dissent
Description: "I will show you the error of your ways."

Name: Ancient Problem Solver
Description: “Throughout history we have seen one continued method of solving all problems. Violence.”

Name: Broken Mast
Description: "The ship crashed into the rocky shore of Aeternum shattering the hull and the mast. Survivors quickly scrambled to gather whatever weapon they could as they faced the Drowned on the shores."

Name: Dirtnap
Description: "Spar with me and I will let you rest for eternity."

Name: Dynasty's Rise
Description: "The truly elite soldiers of the Dynasty forces are their spearman. Their agile movements and unbreakable will made them a deadly force poised to conquer any who stood in their way."

Name: Earthspike
Description: "Coated in a fine poison. Pain is all your enemies shall know."

Name: Forester's Pike
Description: "Snap a Dryad in half, sharpen it to a point and you have made yourself a pike!"

Name: Forward Progress
Description: "Ancient scientists cared little for conflict, but they found weapons useful to further their research."

Name: Graverobber's Spear
Description: "Graverobbing, ever the risky business. If you aren't well equipped, surely the competition will be."

Name: Heir's Domain
Description: "To learn to rule is no easy task."

Name: Heir's Domain
Description: "To learn to rule is no easy task."

Name: Hulking Spear
Description: "The massive size of this weapon makes it unwieldy to wield for humans, yet perfect for the forces of the Corrupted."

Name: Icewrought Pike
Description: "Cold to the touch."

Name: Invader's Will
Description: "I shall ascend the ramparts or I shall perish. There is no other choice."

Name: Leandra's Demise
Description: "Slain by her own spear, Leandra would rather die than serve in the corrupted legions."

Name: Living Spear
Description: "This weapon has a mind of its own, wriggling and writhing as the life inside it hungers for flesh."

Name: Marooned Mariner's Spear
Description: "Left on a deserted island with nothing but the clothes on his back and the spear in his hand, he was left to fend for himself against the dangers that awaited."

Name: Piercing Flame
Description: "Let the fire fill your veins."

Name: Pike of the Grand Duelist
Description: "Duels are a popular past time in Aeternum. The impermenance of death allows fighters to give each duel their all without a regard for their life."

Name: Sentinel Captain's Spear
Description: “Previously wielded by the elite Sentinel Captain of the Ancient Guardians.”

Name: Shattered Shaft
Description: "The shattered husk of a once venerable weapon, this spear has been reforged anew. Though it has lost some of its power, your foes would still be wise to fear you."

Name: Spear of the Elder Shaman
Description: "Magic is not limited to the arcane. What strange magics the Dryads of Reekwater wield is just as potent as that of the Ancients."

Name: Spear of the Lost Queen
Description: "For ages kings and queens have sought power. When news of Aeternum began to circulate the Old World, some rulers were bold enough to venture to this new land themselves. Their subjects never saw them again."

Name: Temple Explorer's Pike
Description: "When delving in ruins it is wise to carry a large weapon."

Name: Tendril of the Breach
Description: "The spear still tinges with the touch of the void, maintaining some sort of connection to the other side of the corrupted breaches."

Name: The Surgeon's Scalpel
Description: "A fine instrument is necessary for the precision required to dismantle an enemy."

Name: Truestrike
Description: "Always finds your foe."

Name: Wildwood Spear
Description: “If a weapon could have a joyous personality, this spear surely would.”

Name: Flawless Grandmaster's Spear
Description: "To become a grandmaster spearman requires decades of training and dedication. When one achieves such an unparalleled feat they are given a spear crafted by the finest artisans of Aeternum."

Name: Faedragon's Claw
Description: "If dragons ever did exist in their land, then surely this weapon is forged from one of their claws. The sheer size of such a claw speaks to the possibility."

Name: Hidden Truths
Description: "Look beyond the curtain, not all is as it may seem."

Name: Soulforged Spear
Description: "How many countless souls were stolen by this weapon and damned to a torment worse than death?"

Name: Alchemist's Pot Stirrer
Description: "Just how big is the alchemical pot that requires a stirring rod this large? And why does this spear seem to soak up half of the reagents?"

Name: Anarchy
Description: "Come, the revolution has begun! Grab your spears and pitchforks and let us storm the keep!"

Name: Ancient Tidings
Description: "Welcome to Aeternum, where your demise is just around the corner!"

Name: Archaeologist's Defender
Description: "Aeternum is an archaeologist's paradise with ruins galore to explore."

Name: Archon's Frozen Spear
Description: "Mages specialize in a variety of magics, but those who favor frost have found spears to be an effective conduit for their spells."

Name: Azoth Imbued Spear
Description: "Brimming with pure azoth infusion, this spear is bursting at the seams with raw energy."

Name: Blight's Spike
Description: "Blight is the Dryad's most hated enemy. Let this weapon guide you to their death."

Name: Blood Eagle Spear
Description: "A cruel ceremony, the blood eagle is fit only for the lowest of the low."

Name: Brittle Longspear
Description: "It seems as if it will break the second you strike something with it."

Name: Broadside Sticker
Description: "Hit their ship from the side! Thrust your spears into the wood of their ship, board it, and slay them all!"

Name: Callous Javelin
Description: "Throw me and see where I land."

Name: Caudanthe, Fang of Serpens
Description: “The monster lashed out, striking its creators down with a single blow.”

Name: Chaos Spear
Description: "Every strike causes confusion. Every use leads to upheaval."

Name: Charge of the Empress
Description: "My royal subjects, I ask that you assist me in the conquest of this land in the name of the Tempest."

Name: Cold-Blooded Killer
Description: "Show no remorse."

Name: Conqueror's Spear
Description: "Shatter the walls and storm the keep, this city shall fall."

Name: Corrupted Captain's Pike
Description: "A brave captain, beloved by all who knew him. Like all the others, he too succumbed to the alure of corruption."

Name: Corruption's Rebirth
Description: "Your dark rebirth shall grant you powers beyond your comprehension."

Name: Farmer's Hope
Description: "Bandits descended on the farm, prepared to steal all the farmer had worked to grow. She gripped her trusty friend and prepared to fight."

Name: Galleon's Spearhead
Description: "Ripped from the front of a crashed galleon, this spearhead is perfect for boarding ships and slaying enemies."

Name: Grand Archmage Morigos's Ancient Spear
Description: "The inscription is muddled but you can make out the words "Morigos" and "Archmage". When you wield the spear it seems to speak to you."

Name: Hellsplitter
Description: "Free us from the bonds of hell and give us life anew."

Name: Hollow Demise
Description: "Death is so...empty."

Name: Horror of the Night
Description: "For all the horrors the townsfolk may see during the day, what comes at night is far worse than what they can imagine."

Name: Humming Crystal Javelin
Description: "The spearhead vibrates as you move the spear from side to side."

Name: Isomir, the Blighted Tender's Spear
Description: "The Greenkeeper was charged with guarding the most sacred of places to the Dryads. The spread of blight into such a sanctuary does not bode well for their kind."

Name: Junglestrike
Description: "The jungles are my domain. Enter if you dare."

Name: Lightning's Call
Description: "Your enemies will be shocked by your power."

Name: Lightningstrike
Description: “Perhaps if you infuse this weapon with enough shadow energy it will transform.”

Name: Long Forgotten Pike
Description: "Dusty and crusty, this spear was left in a Guardian armory for centuries. Despite the wear and tear, the point of the spear is as sharp as ever."

Name: Magmaquake
Description: "Thrust the spear into the ground and let loose the fires of hell."

Name: Nguyen's Notched Spear
Description: "What is yours shall soon belong to The Taker."

Name: Oranath, Spear of the Corrupted Servant
Description: "The Corrupted Keeper kept watch over this citadel for generations. Thousands felt his wrath."

Name: Pestillent Shortspear
Description: "May this spear be a plague upon those who would do you wrong."

Name: Phoenix's Flight
Description: "When thrown this javelin appears as if a flaming phoenix soaring through the sky."

Name: Poseidon's Trident
Description: "The seas are yours to command."

Name: Renewed Faith
Description: "I had lost hope in humanity, but you have restored it."

Name: Rumbling Demise
Description: "When the earth quakes my fury shall come for you."

Name: Shard of a Memory
Description: "Despite all of the atrocities she has committed, Isabella was once human like us."

Name: Siren Queen's Sparring Spear
Description: "To spar with the Siren Queen is the highest honor she grants to her subjects. Few are invited, and fewer leave her arena alive."

Name: Spear of Destiny
Description: "Your destiny is yours to command!"

Name: Spear of Eternal Torment
Description: "Suffering does not stop when you die. You are simply reborn to suffer all over again."

Name: Spear of Hades
Description: "The realm of death is mine to command, but its denizens are yours to do with as you will."

Name: Spear of Malcontent
Description: "Satisfaction is for the unimaginative."

Name: Spear of Shattered Souls
Description: "First she broke my heart, then she ripped out my soul."

Name: Spear of the Corrupted Assault
Description: "They came for us as the sun dipped below the horizon. The red glow of their priests danced upon the trees. When night finally came, they descended upon our walls."

Name: Spear of the Cruel Mage
Description: "The mage toyed with me for hours, experimenting with all forms of magic to torture me. When he let his guard down for but a moment, I seized my opportunity and thrust my spear into his heart."

Name: Spear of the First Snow
Description: "The first snow of each year is the most beautiful. A shame it needs to be coated with your blood."

Name: Spear of the Praetorian Guard
Description: "Few souls have ever wileded a spear like the Praetorian Guard. Their talent was unmatched and their fervor was relentless."

Name: Sprigganstrike
Description: "A well placed spear can strike between the warped and tangled wood that spriggans use for armor.

Name: Stormbound Conduit
Description: "Why bring the storm to others when you can bring the storm to you?"

Name: Stormsong
Description: "A haunting melody that makes your hair stand on end, your mouth taste of metal, and your skin tingle."

Name: Tempered Expectations
Description: "I urge you my friends, do not get your hopes up. This island has a way of crushing them."

Name: Temper Tantrum
Description: "Throw ration and reason out the window and let passion make your choices for you."

Name: Tempest's Whirling Fury
Description: "The song of the Tempest lures many to this land. Her unbridled fury is what keeps so many here."

Name: Unjust Executer
Description: "What are you being executed for? Nothing more than my pleasure."

Name: Valor's Spear
Description: "The prophecy speaks of a champion who shall one day be worthy to wield this spear and bring balance to the world."

Name: Veilstrike
Description: "Strike down the veil that separates us from them. Let corruption run wild through this world."

Name: Waverush
Description: "My power shall rush over you as a wave rushes over a shell."

Name: Weedkiller
Description: "Dryad's are like a weed upon the land. You must kill them while they're small or they'll spread and ruin it all."

Name: Wicked Spear of the West
Description: "Once belonged to a warrior who terrorized a village. Mysteriously, a collosal stone one day fell upon her head."

Name: Sky Asunder
Description: "The heavens split and broke upon the field of battle with such force that none remained standing."

Name: Bloody Thirst
Description: Slurp.

Name: Sunrise Spear
Description: With a new day come new radiant possibilities.

Name: Balance of Duat
Description: The difference between living and dying is as thin as the tip of the spear.

Name: Khnum's Key
Description: And with this spear the waters flow, pouring over the land.

Name: Threefold Stormgore
Description: "With thunder. With lightning. With lance."

Name: Poseidon's Inheritance
Description: The strength of an ocean storm will ravage all that is around the wielder.

Name: Biggus
Description: The complex hieroglyphs have been scratched out by a graverobber, and this name was in their place.

Name: Adept Cryomancer's Gauntlet
Description: A magical gauntlet well-suited to the expertise level of an Adept Cryomancer.

Name: Chilling Reception
Description: "Greetings from the world of souls, you're quite welcome to stay. Leaving, on the other hand..."

Name: Touch of Frost
Description: "Brings with it a hint of harsher winter to come."

Name: Icy Preservation
Description: "It was ever so important to keep the books and texts at just the right temperature, so they would last forever."

Name: Captain's Perogative
Description: "It is the captain's right to take what they desire from those who are against them."

Name: Naturally Cold
Description: "Some things are just cold by nature."

Name: Malikor's Last Grasp
Description: "As cold as the grave, his hands reach out to bring his enemies closer to their deaths."

Name: Gravekeeper's Glove
Description: "Nothing protects against corpses like a cold deeper than that of the grave."

Name: Whisper from the Frozen Vale
Description: "Sometimes, if you listen closely, the frozen hills tell stories of the things they have seen."

Name: Arctic Dusk
Description: "At sunset, even the tundra can appear warm and inviting."

Name: Alchemical Safety Gloves
Description: "Wearing proper hand protection is key when performing transmutations."

Name: Frigid Grip
Description: "Use these to bend fate to your will."

Name: FimbulVetr
Description: Marshall the destructive force of the Terrible Winter

Name: Thundersnow
Description: "It's rare, but when it happens...it's breathtaking."

Name: Hand of Denier
Description: "Filled with a power from beyond the grave, seeking something to replace what was once lost."

Name: Arctic Depths
Description: "Feel the steady strength of this gauntlet, as stable as the deep arctic currents which find their way across the sea."

Name: Night Terror
Description: "It captures the feeling of lying frozen in bed, unable to free yourself from the nightmares."

Name: Touch of Grief
Description: "A chill goes through your bones, and your soul cries out in misery."

Name: Lobstercatcher
Description: "It is said lobsters move slower in cold water, which makes it easier to catch them."

Name: Subduer's Wrath
Description: "Let them escape. We can punish them more severely."

Name: Conservation of Heat
Description: "The transformation of energy is not lost, but contained within the powers of this gauntlet."

Name: Brine of the Frosty Shore
Description: "A pleasant beach can turn into a rimey waste if the season turns too quickly."

Name: Frostfall
Description: "Even more silent than snowfall, frostfall strikes without warning."

Name: Frozen Embrace
Description: "Some people tell tales of a woman in the snow, a Yuki-onna. If you see her, stay away."

Name: Frozen Spate
Description: "The icy water stretched out endlessly in front of us, but we continued nonetheless."

Name: Glacial Gaze
Description: "Her eyes were blue like the deepest frozen rivers."

Name: Glacial Rage
Description: "Anger and vengeance burn white hot. Rage is deeper, colder. It turns your heart to ice."

Name: Glacial Rage
Description: "Anger and vengeance burn white hot. Rage is deeper, colder. It turns your heart to ice."

Name: Frost Fairy's Gift
Description: "And with a wink, she snapped her fingers. My hand grew cold, but with that feeling came the knowledge of creation."

Name: Master Cryomancer's Gauntlet
Description: A magical gauntlet made for a Master Cryomancer, provided its wielder matches its potential.

Name: Crystalline Curse
Description: "After she uttered the incantation, her lover turned to the clearest crystal anyone had seen."

Name: Biting Resonance
Description: "The morning after a heavy snow may seem quiet, but the right sound carries further."

Name: Diarmud's Icy Grasp
Description: "Diarmud made a name for himself exploring the military applications of magic."

Name: Ever Giving
Description: "As snow falls from the sky, the gift of winter calm spreads to all caught outside."

Name: Fractured Bough
Description: "I heard cracks in the distance. At first I thought them to be muskets, but they were trees collapsing under the weight of winter."

Name: Frostbitten Mitt
Description: "What did it cost you? Your fingers and toes? Was it worth it?"

Name: Frostbitten Mitt
Description: "What did it cost you? Your fingers and toes? Was it worth it?"

Name: Frozen Fingers
Description: The fingers on this brittle gauntlet seem to flex and grasp of their own accord.

Name: Gripping Rime
Description: "The rime of the winter seas change a person. Be wary."

Name: In the Quiet
Description: "The peaceful quiet of a dark winter's night belies its danger. Do not give in."

Name: Járngreipr
Description: "It was with a glove like this that Thor was able to take hold of Mjölnir."

Name: Peaceful Chill
Description: "Close your eyes and give into the cold."

Name: Pilgrimage's End
Description: "This is merely a place to rest, before the long return journey begins."

Name: Promise of Malevolence
Description: "There is no sweeter promise than that of Malevolence when brough to full bloom."

Name: Rigor Mortis
Description: "As strong as a fist clenched forever in anger. As cold as a corpse, dead for twenty days."

Name: Siren's Staccato
Description: "Like hail upon the deck of a ship, the Siren's Staccato sings out to its foes."

Name: Winterbite
Description: "Snow is soft. Ice is violent."

Name: Death's Grip
Description: "Anyone unfortunate enough to be killed by it will tell you: this gauntlet’s chill will chase you even into the beyond."

Name: Winter's Breath
Description: "Expertly crafted by people who know a thing or two about cold things."

Name: Crystal Floe
Description: A heavy piece of ice floated down from the North and was forged into this gauntlet. Don't ask how.

Name: Frosted Tips
Description: You feel extra cool wielding this item.

Name: Borealis
Description: Beautiful and rare, this gauntlet was inspired by the sky from the smith's homeland.

Name: Black Ice
Description: This gauntlet is quite dangerous but the danger is due to the corruption

Name: Frozen Hope
Description: This cold hand sucks the joy out of those around it to feed its wearer.

Name: Psychopomp's Ma'at
Description: Justice transcends life and death.

Name: Dead Claws
Description: Taken from the corpse of a powerful beast, these claws still thrum with strength even in death.

Name: Moondisk Vise
Description: "May the light of the Moon guide your paths on the road, guide your hands at your work, and guide your souls away from Aeternum."

Name: Wavebreak
Description: Crush your foes under the weight of the sea.

Name: Shattered Storm
Description: "The crack of lightning leaves a dark energy in the air."

Name: Shadowfury
Description: "I hear the shadows scream, their fury empowers me."

Name: Nightwatcher
Description: "Despite the darkness, nothing escapes my sight."

Name: Sinister Malice
Description: "A sense of impending doom falls over you."

Name: Fanged Grimace
Description: "All who look upon it shudder in fear."

Name: Eternal Malice
Description: "The corrupting evil of the Void is inescapable."

Name: Disintegrating Spite
Description: "Not all can handle the Void's power, some crumble to dust."

Name: Draining Curse
Description: "My sanity falters, yet power coarses through my veins."

Name: Tainted Grip
Description: "Your hand stings where it touches the gauntlet."

Name: Willbreaker
Description: "Even the strongest will crumbles in the face of the Void."

Name: Dark Deceit
Description: "The truth is shrouded by darkness."

Name: Boundless Scourge
Description: "Suffering extends throughout the land."

Name: Reaping Annihilation
Description: "Some actions have inescapable consequences"

Name: Nullbreak
Description: "A crack is opened. The Void seeps through."

Name: Draining Palm
Description: "From your palm into reality, dark energy is shaped."

Name: Hunger Pain
Description: "The hunger for power must be fed."

Name: Electric Void
Description: "Sometimes Void Magic can be electrifying."

Name: Severed Spirit
Description: "No pain is greater than when the spirit is torn from its body."

Name: Desolate Soul
Description: "A soul wanders through the Void, searching for a way home."

Name: Lost Morals
Description: "Morals are lost where power is found."

Name: Adept Void Mage's Gauntlet
Description: "With Pyromancy and Cryomancy, the concept is simple. Elements are easily understood. But the concept of the absence of things is much harder to grasp. The first step is to empty your mind completely."

Name: Piercing Cold
Description: "The air is warm, yet he shivers."

Name: Essence of the Void
Description: "Unknowable, yet unfalteringly powerful."

Name: Horrific Essence
Description: "This is truly what nightmares are made of."

Name: Ultimate Sacrifice
Description: "What would you give, for all the power in the world?"

Name: Raging Pain
Description: "Your body screams in agony."

Name: Voidsnap
Description: "In an instant, Void Magic floods the room."

Name: Dark Harvest
Description: "All things have a darkness within, ready to be reaped."

Name: Mesmerizing Power
Description: "Their sights were set upon this power, nothing could distract them."

Name: Final Harvest
Description: "When the Void reaps, only the strong will remain."

Name: Corrosive Current
Description: "Your veins burn, your blood wants to escape."

Name: Voidravager
Description: "The Void leaves nothing intact."

Name: Malicious Vigor
Description: "You feel strong and alert, yet you don't quite trust the feeling."

Name: Ultimate Wrath
Description: "It was the final straw. Wrath was unleashed."

Name: Creeping Fog
Description: "A dark fog settles, unnoticed until its too late."

Name: Damned Fist
Description: "Condemned to wield unthinkable power, a blessing or a curse?"

Name: Ghostspark
Description: "Although dead, there's still a spark within."

Name: Hand of Rage
Description: "Red hot with anger, then darkened by the Void."

Name: Furious Temper
Description: "The Captain's men feared his temper, none dared defy his will."

Name: Voidstudy
Description: "Carefully crafted so the Void Magic could be anaylzed."

Name: Soul Spice
Description: "A little bit of flavor makes consuming souls more palatable."

Name: Creeping Dread
Description: "Cleanse the land of Corruption, cleanse it of its dread."

Name: Surging Hatred
Description: "She inhaled deeply and focused on the lies of her life. She was more than an accessory. More than passing dalliance. She was the tip of the spear, fueled by the hatred she bore the society that had repeatedly failed to force her into a place she didn't belong."

Name: Vile Mercy
Description: "After a battle, you find sometimes yourself in the cruelest of positions, where you kill not out of anger or the need to protect yourself...but to end the suffering of those you can't save."

Name: Ravenous Cruelty
Description: "The Void is insatiable. Feed it."

Name: Mad Sacrifice
Description: "His sanity was gone, but his power was now immeasurable."

Name: Null Energy
Description: "A feeling of emptiness flows through you."

Name: Venomous Spite
Description: "Looks can't kill, but they can poison."

Name: Sinister Sacrifice
Description: "All you have to give up is your empathy."

Name: Decaying Greed
Description: "Strength grows, the heart rots."

Name: Putrid Pit
Description: "He yells to be let out, but he's too deep to be heard."

Name: Hand of Fate
Description: "The strings of destiny are pulled by this gauntlet's fingers."

Name: Fading Light
Description: "The light at the end of the tunnel fades."

Name: Echo of Souls
Description: "Out of the corner of your eye appear afterimages of lost souls."

Name: Boneharvest
Description: "Bones ground to dust feed the Void."

Name: Spiritreaper
Description: "One by one, spirits are consumed."

Name: Night Feast
Description: "The moon rises, howls echo. The feast has begun."

Name: Unending Anguish
Description: "The torment is inescapable, but increases your power."

Name: Wraithkeeper
Description: "Only gauntlets such as these could contain wraiths."

Name: Soulstriker
Description: "Nothing is more vulnerable than the soul."

Name: Hollow Reality
Description: "As reality crumbles, so do your foes."

Name: Bane of Shadows
Description: "Fear is struck in the heart of the shadows."

Name: Zealous Rage
Description: "Rage is an intense motivator."

Name: Ghastly Grief
Description: "Deafening wails pierce your eardrums."

Name: Judgement Day
Description: "He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people."

Name: Disciple of the Void
Description: "Come, all who are faithful. The Void welcomes you."

Name: Cruel Defiance
Description: "The Void listens to no one."

Name: Ghostkeeper
Description: "A trapped ghost feeds the Void."

Name: Dusktide
Description: "The tide rises and falls, stopped by nothing."

Name: Darkshell
Description: "Crafted from a shell, infused with Void Magic."

Name: Hunger for Power
Description: "The need for more power is insatiable."

Name: Vicious Drain
Description: "Violently take what is rightfully yours."

Name: Umbral Iron
Description: "A piece of Ironjaw's bone, pulsating with Void Magic."

Name: Cutting Cruelty
Description: "The Void cuts like a sharpened spear."

Name: Spirit's Rest
Description: "Those lost in battle rest, lending what they have left to the Void."

Name: Raging Spirit
Description: "He enters a blind rage, nearly destroying that which he sought to protect."

Name: Great Desolation
Description: "Only emptiness is left behind."

Name: Dark Drifter
Description: "From shadow to shadow, she leaps."

Name: Lightcrusher
Description: "A light is snuffed out, like a candle between his fingers."

Name: Torn Veil
Description: "A glimpse beyond the veil, nothing but Void."

Name: Sinister Reach
Description: "It creeps out, reaching beyond the Void."

Name: Desperate Plea
Description: "He gasps his final plea, before being consumed by the Void."

Name: Wretched Grasp
Description: "If he loosened his grip, it would all fall away."

Name: Dire Fate
Description: "Even once known, one's fate cannot be defied."

Name: Vast Anguish
Description: "Pain like this has never been felt before."

Name: Malevolent Might
Description: "You're empowered by Void Magic, you sense its ill intentions."

Name: Shadow Tempest
Description: "The Void rages like a wild storm."

Name: A Terrible Echo
Description: "The wail carried through the mountains, silencing the birds...and waking the horrors."

Name: Weeping Rage
Description: "The tears were not of sadness, but of anger. She was ash in his arms. They would pay the same price."

Name: New Moon's Curse
Description: "Look at the stars on a new moon's night. Never will they shine as bright. Use their light to walk your path, ere shadows make you breathe your last. --Aeternum Travelers' Rhyme

Name: Black Hole
Description: "The pull of the Void is inescapable."

Name: Wicked Fury
Description: "Screams of violent anger escape from its fingertips."

Name: Aeternum's Echo
Description: "What existed before Aeternum, and what power did it contain?"

Name: Soulreaper
Description: "Most effective when the souls are ripe."

Name: Bloodmoon
Description: "The bloodmoon rises and the Void is empowered."

Name: Malevolance
Description: "The glint of the gauntlet betrays its evil nature."

Name: Hallowed Fist
Description: "A feeble attempt at counteracting Void Magic's corruption."

Name: Raging Greed
Description: "After tasting the Void's power, one becomes insatiable."

Name: Deadfingers
Description: "Everything he touches, withers."

Name: Arcane Shadow
Description: "The shadow's power is understood by few"

Name: Devouring Fear
Description: "A man was devoured, not by a beast, but by the terror the beast instilled."

Name: Great Decay
Description: "All things march towards their demise."

Name: Shadow Weaver
Description: "A powerful tool for commanding hordes of shadows."

Name: Dark Feast
Description: "A great feast is revealed. Every vice you could desire is on the menu."

Name: Stormtear
Description: "A strike in the sky ripped it apart, revealing the Void beyond."

Name: Boneweaver
Description: "My own skeleton, what a powerful tool."

Name: Shadowkeeper
Description: "Shadows must be kept at bay, lest they consume all."

Name: Dusk
Description: "Darkness reaches its peak, the void is happy."

Name: Twilight
Description: "Darkness peaks out from the horizon, the void lurks."

Name: Midnight Moon
Description: "She sparkles softly, hauntingly beautiful."

Name: Shattered Nebula
Description: "Clouds among the stars pulse with Void Magic."

Name: Gloom
Description: "Blinded by the Void, you still feel it around you."

Name: Obsidian Terror
Description: "Beyond its shiny exterior lurks malevolence."

Name: Spectral Arson
Description: "A great dark fire once burned, ravaging all in its path."

Name: Ghostclaw
Description: "Something growls hauntingly outside your tent. You peer out, and see nothing."

Name: Sacrificial Lamb
Description: "What did it cost, to gain all that power?"

Name: Freezing Void
Description: "The Void Magic sends a chill down your spine."

Name: Piercing Horror
Description: "Fear of the Void cuts straight to the heart."

Name: Souldrain
Description: "Screams echo from each soul gathered."

Name: Raging Strikers
Description: "Blind rage, absolute power."

Name: Absolute Terror
Description: "You stare into the Void, the Void stares back."

Name: Violent Misery
Description: "Violence is this energy's only escape from the body."

Name: Shattered Souls
Description: "One soul demolished, another empowered."

Name: Lightkiller
Description: "As the light is extinguished, the Void grows in power."

Name: Hallowed Torment
Description: "Early wielders of Void Magic revered the pain it caused."

Name: Corrupted Rebirth
Description: "He saught a second chance at life, what he got was worse than death."

Name: Haunting Specter
Description: "A fear sits at the back of the mind, unable to be dispelled."

Name: Refreshing Harvest
Description: "My life drained, my power restored."

Name: Dark Vengeance
Description: "They seek retribution, losing themselves along the way."

Name: Curseweaver
Description: "A curse placed deep enough is impossible to dispel."

Name: Decayed Spirit
Description: "Whatever good was once in his spirit has long since faded."

Name: Voidroot
Description: "Extracted from a Void infused tree."

Name: Corrosive Earth
Description: "Void Magic resides where it pleases, even within the earth."

Name: Warshade
Description: "It wanders the battlefield, fed by the conflict that occurs."

Name: Unstoppable Decay
Description: "All that lives must someday die."

Name: Rotten Limb
Description: "It emanates putrid scent, almost as strong as the power within."

Name: Bonerot
Description: "Unfortunately, it's going to have to be amputated."

Name: Disintegrating Depths
Description: "Deeper and deeper he went, his reality crumbling."

Name: Wild Blight
Description: "Its corrosive energy rages like a wild beast."

Name: Corrupt Sacrifice
Description: "She gives, so that she may take."

Name: Morbid Gift
Description: "They accept it solemnly, knowing what it cost."

Name: Inevitable Desolation
Description: "If you won't stop it, who will?"

Name: Heaven's Rift
Description: "The sky opens, power peeks through."

Name: Vow of Vengeance
Description: "I won't let him get away with this."

Name: Tarnished Soul
Description: "He knew nothing could restore his soul to what it once was."

Name: Murky Waters
Description: "Nothing was clear, except that the Void was near."

Name: Immortal Abyss
Description: "Those who fall in never escape."

Name: Silent Grief
Description: "He stares ahead blankly. His eyes betray his grief."

Name: Swiftshadow
Description: "No matter how fast you move, your shadow keeps up."

Name: Deadfist
Description: "They felt nothing in their hand, yet were still aware of the power within."

Name: Voidmist
Description: "Damp and dark, the Void sits around you."

Name: Call of the Void
Description: "You stand at the edge of the Void, curious what may happen if you enter."

Name: Mortifying Clutch
Description: "He couldn't let go, he was too ashamed."

Name: Wine Dark Night
Description: "You don't know true darkness until the moon isn't there to light your way."

Name: Starless Sky
Description: "No stars in sight, only Void fills the sky."

Name: Wretched Grip
Description: "He holds on tight, nothing left to keep him from falling."

Name: Empty Conscience
Description: "More room left for power."

Name: Reign of Darkness
Description: "The rule of light is over, only darkness remains."

Name: Soulcrusher
Description: "Void magic can do real physical harm, but the true toll taken is on the soul. Injuries from void magic can eat away at your will to continue onward in this place."

Name: Master Void Mage's Gauntlet
Description: "'Empty your mind,' they said. Not a simple task. I attempted it for years. It wasn't until I was utterly lost and jaded that my magic began to develop. For me it wasn't the absence of everything...it was the presence of despair."

Name: Empty Promise
Description: "Words are nothing. Deeds are everything. Every promise is worthless until it is fulfilled."

Name: Frozen Shadow
Description: "A whisper in the darkness tells you to press on, for if you stop, you won't move another step."

Name: Mormo
Description: That which is found between places. By Her many names, we call. The ending of the prayer is Mormo.

Name: Grasp of Ammit
Description: One cannot escape the inevitable, all come to Ammit in the end.

Name: Hand That Feeds
Description: This hand bites back.

Name: Tortuous Inferos
Description: "This shadowflame has been known to bite the hand that holds it. Perhaps you will be luckier."

Name: Hand of the Primus
Description: An important tool for signifying the wielder's position.

Name: Jaws of Oblivion
Description: Their heart was found to be impure, and Ammit devoured their soul.

Name: Chiromancer's Palm
Description: Follow the dark strand of Fate across the palm this hand...

Name: Great Horned Helm
Description: "Rams horns are fashioned onto the sides of the helm, creating a large menacing visage."

Name: Waterlogged Commander's Breastplate
Description: "Traveling to Aeternum is risky business. Many perish en route, but their armor and weapons remain behind."

Name: Justicar's Chestguard
Description: "Above all else, justice is what matters. And to bring about justice, you must defend yourself from those who would cause injustice."

Name: Molten Mittens
Description: "A syndicate alchemist once theorized that the right mixtures of metal would be capable of holding magma. Let's hope they were right."

Name: Olga's Handguards
Description: Olga's old battle-gauntlets have wielded her sword countless times.

Name: Urmir's Stompers
Description: Urmir's boots have stood steadfast against waves of men and monsters alike.

Name: Crown of Cruelty
Description: "Spiked barbs dig into your head as you place the helm upon your head. Your pain becomes your rage."

Name: Blademaster's Harness
Description: "Fervently striking with a blade requires the great Blademasters of the world to craft special armor. While they need to remain protected, they must also remain nimble and free to move around their enemies."

Name: Crushing Grips
Description: "Grotesquely large, these gauntlets are dense enough to pummel a rock into dust or crush the windpipe of a would-be bandit."

Name: Malchezar's Legguards
Description: "The great Malchezar was as fine a warrior as he was a mage. Beneath his flowing robes he lined himself with coldforged steel that protected him until he died of old age."

Name: Waterwalkers
Description: "A traveling merchant promised these boots had the power to walk on water. What they did not mention was that the water on which you could walk was located at the very bottom of the lake."

Name: Headguard of Valor
Description: "A proper knight should wear a proper helm."

Name: Helm of the Dominator
Description: "Worn by the corrupted General Gortan, his crushing control over the legions he commanded led to a mutiny that resulted in his undoing."

Name: Helm of the Forgotten Legion
Description: "The Legion came from Rome centuries ago. They tried to return home time and time again, each time landing back on the shores of Aeternum."

Name: Horrific Skullcap
Description: "The helmet is nothing more than the skull of some brute plated with starmetal on all sides."

Name: Warscarred Faceplate
Description: "Centuries of wear and deflected strikes decorate the helmet. It is nothing if not effective,"

Name: Lion's Paw Helmet
Description: "A long lost helm of an ancient batallion, the sheer ferocity of this armor is clear the moment you set eyes on it."

Name: Possessed Helmet
Description: "You hear voices the moment you don the helmet. Whispering in your ear, they compel you to do awful deeds."

Name: Crown of Sobek
Description: "Heavy is the reptilian head that wears the crown."

Name: King of the Jungle
Description: No beast will question your dominion.

Name: Castrum Crown of the Goat-King
Description: As protective as a castellum, as powerful as a fort.

Name: Vermillion Starshield
Description: A red, baleful eye glares out from this helm.

Name: Steelsworn Breastplate
Description: "The Steelsworn smiths crafted the finest armor for only the fiercest of warriors. They did not accept coin as their payment, only the blood of the uninitiated."

Name: Enchanted Armor of the Forest Keeper
Description: "The Dryads do not wear armor forged of steel. But their enchanted wood can block a blade all the same."

Name: Dragon's Breath Breastplate
Description: "Forged in the fire of the dragon's flame, this dark black breastplate is decorated with intricate metal designs of the dragon from which it came."

Name: Blazing Breastplate
Description: "The armor is warm to the touch, providing excquisite protection from the cold."

Name: Azoth Infused Chestpiece
Description: "Built in a cave by what some would describe as a mad scientist, he used the armor to escape from his would be captors and fight his way to freedom."

Name: Iceforged Chestguard
Description: "The grandmaster smiths are known for their artistry with the strangest of materials. A breastplate made of pure ice is but one of many oddities they created over the years."

Name: Commodor's Battlearmor
Description: "Most high ranking naval officers prefered to wear their linens at sea for fear of drowning. The boldest among them donned their armor, prepared for battle at any moment."

Name: Royal Breastplate
Description: "Made from the finest metals, this breastplate is fit for royalty. How it came into your possession is a mystery."

Name: Breastplate of Titanic Will
Description: "The Titans of old bestowed this armor upon their favored champion, tasking her to destroy their enemies and all who would oppose them."

Name: Chestguard of the Fallen
Description: "Lined with what initially appear to be scratches, a notch is inked on the armor for each enemy its owner has felled. "

Name: Dunecrawler's Breastplate
Description: "Heavy armor is essential in battle, but in the heat of the desert it can be a death sentence. Denizens have had to adapt over the years."

Name: Armor of Unrelenting Ferocity
Description: "Berserkers are notoriously picky about what weapon they'll wield, but when it comes to armor they care only that it does not get in the way of their lust for blood."

Name: Colossal Stormplate
Description: Not even the strongest winds can pierce this protection.

Name: Monstrous Breastplate
Description: "Weavers from all over Aeternum have both marveled and vomited at the craftsmanship of this piece."

Name: The Brawn
Description: One part of an exquisitely crafted armor set, distributed among the Varangian Knights' esteemed leaders. This piece was tailor-made for Sir Olga the Hewer.

Name: Black Knight's Gauntlets
Description: "Draped from head to toe in coldforged black steel, when the Black Knight rode in to town he appeared as if the spitting image of death."

Name: Enchanted Dryad Gloves
Description: "What some call "gloves" are actually the severed and hollowed hands of a long dead Dryad."

Name: Grips of Fate
Description: "Fate has a hold on us all."

Name: Good News
Description: "Good news all! I've created gloves that can make you luckier!" Reads the note found in the belly of a wolf

Name: Bouldering Gloves
Description: Every small bit of purchase on a stone becomes valuable when you're 50 meters in the air.

Name: Blacksmith's Memento

Name: Legplates of Hate's End

Name: Memory of Stephen

Description: Invigorates the wearer to keep then running, even when they feel they should fall.

Name: Sundrop
Description: The warmth of the sun fills you with a bright incandescence.

Name: Alchemist's Trinket
Description: What alchemy can create is strange, wondrous, and terrifying.

Name: Noble's Earring
Description: A beautiful work of craftsmanship to help you stand out in a crowd.

Name: Anedjti's Sunloop
Description: A glint of hope in a sea of primordial dark.

Name: Ambrosia's Burden
Description: Divinity is not all that it seems.

Name: Invoked By Her Two Lands
Description: The exile may never return.

Name: Empty Heart Amulet
Description: An amulet in the shape of a heart. Even when placed in fire, the metal does not warm.

Name: Monstrous Amulet
Description: An amulet befitting the monster who once wore it.

Name: Barkskin Torque
Description: A torque worn tightly around the neck. Though flexible, it feels like wood to the touch.

Name: Slimy Wooden Ring
Description: It's slimy. It's wood. It's gross. It's powerful.

Name: Amber Teardrop Earring
Description: An earring made of polished amber.

Name: Waterstone Earring
Description: An earring made of stones smoothed by rushing water. When held close, you can feel the ebb and flow of the tides.

Name: The Space Between
Description: "There is no distance lonlier than the darkness between life and death."

Name: Crusher's Craze
Description: "Like a toddler with a new toy, the man teetered on the brink of insanity, smashing all he could find with his hammer."

Name: Amrine's Forgotten Axe
Description: "This axe seems to have been left behind long ago."

Name: Lost Faith
Description: "Do not give up, the best is yet to come."

Name: Darkness Defined
Description: "The truest of shadows lie in the hearts of men."

Name: Amrine Excavator's Amulet
Description: These amulets are infused with a simple magic that detects toxins in the air and provides a slight ward against them.

Name: Cavern Lurker's Defense
Description: "Light is a rare commodity deep in the caves. One must be ready to defend themselves."

Name: Nakashima's Keepsake
Description: A necklace with an etching of someone the former wearer held close to their heart.

Name: Frozen Mire
Description: "The grime of winter's end always leaves its mark."

Name: Simon Grey's Toothpick
Description: "Clearly Simon Grey did not brush his teeth."

Name: Excavator's Safety Helmet
Description: "Digging around ruins is risky business. One must take as many precautions as possible."

Name: Tomb Raider's Rifle
Description: "Settle in, we're going raiding!"

Name: Burial Spear
Description: "It was once tradition to bury the dead with a weapon so that they could defend themselves in the afterlife. Of course, that tradition stopped once the dead would get right back up and begin fighting you with that weapon."

Name: Simon's Hacksilver Ring
Description: Simon's ring appears to be fashioned from small silver baubles found on his travels.

Name: Flare Spark
Description: "When lightning hits the ground, fire leaps forth."

Name: Staff of the Befouled Temple
Description: "Dark forces run wild in the caverns of Amrine Temple. Only the light can purge them."

Name: Obsidian Edged Musket
Description: "The dark black rock makes this a beautiful rifle."

Name: Graveguard's Seal
Description: An ancient insignia suspended from a chain.

Name: Creeping Cold
Description: "It sneaks up on you. Before you know it, you're shivering. Then you're dead."

Name: Staff of the Immolated Veil
Description: "Ever burning fire guides the way."

Name: Sunderstrike
Description: "No armor can withstand the might of my axe."

Name: Obsidian Rapier
Description: "The obsidian is sharpened and tempered, a fine blade."

Name: Fanged Ring
Description: A ring featuring fang-like protrusions.

Name: Masquerade Mask
Description: A simple but fun wooden mask.

Name: Glacial Longsword
Description: A deep blue hue and a frosty aura make this sword appear as if it is forged in pure ice.

Name: Fleeting Reality
Description: "The weapon seems to shift in and out of this plane of reality. It's neither entirely here nor entirely not."

Name: The Obelisk
Description: "Let this hammer be a pillar of destruction. Sow fear and despair everywhere you go."

Name: Ancient Heartstring
Description: "She had my heart in the palm of her hand, and then she let it go."

Name: Tip of the Morning Star
Description: "The fine point shines in the light of the stars."

Name: Stonehewn Ring
Description: A ring of stone, polished as smooth as glass.

Name: Duplicitous Intent
Description: "My intentions surely are pure."

Name: Rejected Sacrifice
Description: "Not good enough. NOT. GOOD. ENOUGH. Begone, and show your face here no longer!"

Name: Ethereal Visage
Description: "A faint image stained her sight, giving glimpses of a promising future. Or perhaps, her forgotten past."

Name: Willing Sacrifice
Description: “They endlessly throw themselves upon our blades, but for what purpose?"

Name: Corruption's Resurgence
Description: "We thought that corruption was gone, dying a slow death. And then out of nowhere, it erupted."

Name: Voidsong
Description: "Listen closely and hear my promises of power."

Name: Corruption Infused Longbow
Description: "Corruption seeps from the wood around the bow, oozing from every bow. Knocking an arrow causes the corruption to jut towards the fresh wood, trying to corrupt every last splinter of it."

Name: Thorpe's Helmet
Description: Once deeply infused with corruption, it now seems to offer protection against that same dark power.

Name: Desecrated Maul
Description: "An unholy presence lingers around this War Hammer. What was once a weapon of virtue and justice now serves a far darker purpose."

Name: Dark Pyromancer's Spellstaff
Description: "The coven's pyromancers were among the most powerful beings on Aeternum, controlling forces that were not meant to be controlled."

Name: Abyssal Strike
Description: "A weapon of justice and holy intent turned into a weapon of malice."

Name: Frostwall
Description: "A winter storm ebbs and flows within you. Attune yourself to it, and you will find a font of power."

Name: Tundra Warden's Rifle
Description: "Strange beasts lurk on the fringes of the tundra. You never know what you'll run into."

Name: Cave Crawler
Description: It was so named by a frightened adventurer who mistook this gun for a monstrous grub.

Name: Bloodblade
Description: While not forged in blood, it does certainly seem to have an affinity for the substance.

Name: Corrupted Faith
Description: After so many years trapped in a heavily corrupted cave even a pious man would not be the same, much less a humble weapon.

Name: Thorny Musket
Description: "The wood used in the make of this rifle was never sanded down, leaving it rough around the edges."

Name: Charred Waraxe
Description: "Fight through the fire and come out the other side."

Name: Stoneshard Earring
Description: A carefully-carved stone earring.

Name: Glowing Branch
Description: "This staff appears as if it was ripped from the Azoth Tree itself."

Name: Maul of the First Enforcer
Description: "Dryad enforcers have defended the sacred places of Aeternum for millenia. When the first enforcer rose from the earth, they were granted a holy hammer, perfect for fighting back outsiders."

Name: Prowler's Punishment
Description: "She waited until the time was right to strike. She used her enemies movements against him."

Name: Petrified Ring
Description: A ring made of petrified...something...

Name: Rapier of the Restless Blademaster
Description: “She never slept, only trained.”

Name: Staff of Eternal Torment
Description: "Your death is not the end, no no no. You will live out a fiery existence in the afterlife, burning for all ages."

Name: Natural Selection
Description: "That which is not born of nature has no home here."

Name: Demise of the Fae
Description: "The fae were culled from this land when the first humans arrived. Cut down with swords and axes, they stood no chance."

Name: Sight of the Angry Earth
Description: "The Angry Earth do not see the world as we do, they see much much more."

Name: Cave Creeper Necklace
Description: A necklace fashioned from twigs and vines found at the mouth of caves.

Name: Rapier of Forgotten Queens
Description: "Buried among the tombs of queens past, forgotten among the masses of generous rulers the realm had known."

Name: Promise of Power
Description: "Do not resist. I possess that which you desire."

Name: Farseer's Spear
Description: "Gaze into my crystals and see your future."

Name: Dreadwake
Description: “The feared pirate commander succumbed to the corruption. His ship would appear around the shores of Aeternum, his axe in hand, and all that followed was death and destruction.”

Name: Glowing Lifecrystal Staff
Description: "The crystal tipped staff radiates pure life energy, healing all around it."

Name: Flamewake
Description: "All that remains in my path is ash and dust."

Name: Tempest's Call
Description: "She called for me to find Her, and so I left a trail of blood in my wake as I sought Her out."

Name: Taiyings Heart
Description: "Ambition. Loss. Victory. Defeat. The heart endures."

Name: Zealous Embrace
Description: "May you find others who seek your cause, and the power to destroy those that do not."

Name: Accursed End
Description: "Your destiny was never your own. From the beginning my curse was upon you."

Name: Frostforged War Hammer
Description: "The entire weight of the tundra lingers behind your swing."

Name: Bow of the Enchantress
Description: "Sing my song and receive my power."

Name: Madman's Headhunter
Description: "None are safe when the madman is on the loose."

Name: Inner Peace
Description: "Now that your enemies are dead, I hope you find peace."

Name: Pirate's Piece
Description: The extra loudness intimidates its foes.

Name: Wodao
Description: A sword shipped in from faraway from Aeternum. It is of excellent make, as many have safely staked their lives on it in the past.

Name: Traveler's Flail
Description: A traveler brough a curious weapon from a faraway land. It had lost much of its purpose, but still served them well.

Name: Angry Earth Exterminator
Description: "Killing Dryads is oh so fun. And now with this spear you can do it faster than ever!"

Name: Firevine Battlestaff
Description: "Ever-burning vines cover every piece of this staff.

Name: Sacred Woodsabre
Description: "Those who dwell in the forest have their own way of living. Sacred rituals and objects that would be foreign to most."

Name: Edenil
Description: "From the earth we came, to the earth we shall return."

Name: The Settler's Friend
Description: "Only 6 Pence! Don't go to the New World without one!"

Name: Creeping Recurve
Description: "Vines grasp out from the limbs, lusting for flesh."

Name: Subzero Spear
Description: "Even in the heat of the sun this spear remains frozen solid."

Name: Warden's Guise
Description: "Poisonous... poisonous... venomous... poisonous... aha! Wait, no... poisonous..."

Name: Higher Purpose
Description: "You do all that you must in service of the great one."

Name: Blightbone Battleaxe
Description: “A putrid stench lingers on the axe.”

Name: Infamy
Description: "The whole world shall know of your sin."

Name: Winter Wish
Description: "As fatigue sets in, many explorers have tried to continue on. Many explorers have never returned."

Name: Primordial Edge
Description: "Forged from the vines of Malevolence. Unconvential, yet highly effective."

Name: Woodswarden
Description: "Let this hammer be your charge. Guard these woods and remove any would be intruders."

Name: Firebinder
Description: "I can control fire."

Name: Sinful Glare
Description: "Though he hadn't stepped into battle himself, his eyes had seen war. Swords returned chipped, shields dented. But the items that didn't return were always far more apparent."

Name: The Land
Description: Vast and beautiful.

Name: Javelin of Dryadic Empowerment
Description: "Imbued within this weapon is the memory of a thousand Dryads. Their knowledge is now yours to command."

Name: Entlimb
Description: A gift given to a friend of the land. It was viciously stolen from her by brigands and thieves.

Name: Liveliness
Description: Spirits and sprites seem to dance around this blade.

Name: Lifecall
Description: Engraved on the haft is a short prayer, "Through the Living Will, I call thee to return from the Empty End."

Name: Curiosity, Greed
Description: "Even in times of wealth, we vie for more. Behind each door is a chance at even greater power."

Name: Sol
Description: "The heat beats upon the sands of the desert relentlessly. Those who live there have become a hard people, fierce warriors with an intensity like the burning sun."

Name: Will of the Ancients
Description: "What did they desire? And why did they leave?"

Name: Archaeologist's Armored Flintlock
Description: "Opening crusty old tombs leads to ancient creations finding new life."

Name: Final Respite
Description: "Rest now."

Name: Smooth Bone Ring
Description: A ring made from some kind of large animal bone.

Name: Fury
Description: "A thief you can trust is no thief to you."

Name: Inherent Truth
Description: "There is but one truth in this world. We are born, and we die."

Name: Spellstaff of Fiery Intent
Description: "My rage consumes me and my fire shall consume you."

Name: Spear of the Outer Isles
Description: "The outer isles of Aeternum are rich in Azoth making them a desired destination for would-be explorers."

Name: Featherweight Ring
Description: This ring is almost weightless.

Name: Enchanted Earring
Description: This earring has a faint glow to it from some ages-old enchantment that has all but faded.

Name: Guardian's Ire
Description: "This would not be the last time nature was disturbed, nor the last time it was fought for."

Name: Divine Devotion
Description: "I pray that my faith shall set me free."

Name: Lazarus Bow
Description: "Let my arrows bring you back from the brink."

Name: Ancient Intentions
Description: "They sought to create and learn, but they found themselves rife with conflict."

Name: Weaponmaster's Chosen
Description: "Of her many weapons, the great axe was her most treasured, reserved only for the purest of kills."

Name: Blackmetal Stud
Description: A sharp stud of black metal, worn by warriors of old.

Name: Frostgrasp
Description: "What appears delicate can often prove fatal."

Name: Deceit's Design
Description: "The world would move as he wishes, but would not take shape as he expects."

Name: Cold Claw
Description: Your fingers feel frigid as they reach out.

Name: Parry
Description: A simple technique, but any swordsman worth their salt knows not to underestimate a foe who has mastered its use.

Name: Voidsword
Description: It was hidden away by the ancients as they feared its power. Do not hesitate to turn it upon them.

Name: Stonestrike
Description: The flail head for this weapon is carved from heavy voidstone instead of metal like most reasonable weapons.

Name: Twisting Fates
Description: "It whips about in the wind, almost a blur between past and present, present and future."

Name: A Pleasant Reminder
Description: "There is a comfort in the familiar that is not easily shaken. This comfort can lead to many mistakes."

Name: Wayward Thread
Description: "That's the thing of it: it's not a leftover, it's the beginning of something else."

Name: Sunrise Kiss
Description: "May my point strike as true as the first drops of sunlight on the morning dew."

Name: Omen
Description: "It's a flicker at the corner of your eye, a shiver of things to come."

Name: Portent
Description: "They should have seen it coming."

Name: Vision of Viciousness
Description: "If its roots grow unchecked, it becomes all-consuming."

Name: Calamitous Intent
Description: "A hammer truly fit for a monarch."

Name: Fallow Fields
Description: "No crops again this year, we'll starve through the winter."

Name: Infinite Chaos
Description: "Rage against order, embrace the unknown, let nothingness consume you."

Name: Reluctant Savior
Description: "I didn't plan on helping, but I couldn't leave them behind."

Name: Emberstone's Promise
Description: "When Giada Emberstone swore she would avenge her husband's killers, she had no idea what it would entail."

Name: Glacial Sorrow
Description: "A day so cold even your tears freeze before touching the snow."

Name: Blackguard's Longsword
Description: "Don't discount the value of a longsword. It might not be as flashy or imtimidating as the rest, but it'll make short work of anyone you come across, whether they're a fighter or not."

Name: Blackguard's Rapier
Description: "All it takes to win is a handful of dirt at the right moment."

Name: Blackguard's Hatchet
Description: "Many a limb has been taken by this one. I keep them as trophies on my mantle."

Name: Blackguard's Greataxe
Description: "It was easy. By the time we starved them out I could cut through two or three at a time."

Name: Blackguard's Warhammer
Description: "I crush everything. Doors, bones, dreams."

Name: Blackguard's Spear
Description: "...So I turned around and pinned him to a wall with this!"

Name: Blackguard's Bow
Description: "The whisper of an arrow isn't the noise you worry about. It's the sound it makes when it strikes true."

Name: Blackguard's Musket
Description: "The family of my enemies are fair game."

Name: Blackguard's Life Staff
Description: "Even a Blackguard gets hurt from time to time. That's why we've got this!"

Name: Blackguard's Fire Staff
Description: "This old girl has seen some good use. I lost count of the number of villages she's burned."

Name: Blackguard's Ice Gauntlet
Description: "Freezing a person solid always results in interesting statuary."

Name: Blackguard's Void Gauntlet
Description: "The beauty of this thing is I can tear you apart and put you back together with it."

Name: Blackguard's Kite Shield
Description: "Sometimes a village will get wind of us before we can take them by surprise, so we send in the boys with these and work our way in from there.

Name: Blackguard's Blunderbuss
Description: "Don't worry, I'll simply leave you in pieces."

Name: Blackguard's Greatsword
Description: This weapon was meant to slay the demon's infesting the sanctuary. Unfortunately. It didn’t.

Name: Conqueror's Breastplate
Description: "Blackguard Conquerors are a sensitive bunch, that's why their hearts are so well protected."

Name: Conqueror's Helm
Description: "Sometimes when people are terrified, they throw things. Those things bounce off of this."

Name: Conqueror's Greaves
Description: "Stout protection from the pleading hands of your victims."

Name: Conqueror's Boots
Description: "These boots were built to crush your victims underfoot."

Name: Conqueror's Gauntlets
Description: "Nearly as devastating as the weapons they hold."

Name: Raider's Coat
Description: "Pull it up across your shoulders so they can't see your face."

Name: Raider's Hat
Description: "Keep the brim low, it'll keep the light from glinting off your eyes."

Name: Raider's Pants
Description: "These hardly make a sound when you're moving through the grass."

Name: Raider's Boots
Description: "Soft soles make moving through darkend alleys easy work."

Name: Raider's Gloves
Description: "These still grip well enough when slick with blood."

Name: Tactician's Shirt
Description: "Armor? Don't need it. The Raiders and Conquerors go in ahead of me."

Name: Tactician's Hat
Description: "No good raid happens without a good plan. We plan to plunder."

Name: Tactician's Pants
Description: "Flexible and easy to walk in. An absolute necessity for moving about a burning village."

Name: Tactician's Shoes
Description: "Comfortable walking shoes make the roads to and from a raid easier on the bunions."

Name: Tactician's Gloves
Description: "I use these to point at what to kill or destroy next. They also keep my hands warm."

Name: Doomwalker's Breastplate
Description: "The scars on this breastplate tell the stories of its victories."

Name: Doomwalker's Helm
Description: "She spent hours tirelessly holding the line as waves of monsters crashed against her shield. We thought her dead and went to check after the battle's end. There she stood, an onyx monolith, blood-soaked and smiling.

Name: Pious Scout's Hat
Description: "Every scout whispers a prayer as the enemy draws near."

Name: Pious Scout's Coat
Description: "Let no man see my presence."

Name: Honest Thief's Shirt
Description: "A poignant reminder of the day I met her."

Name: Honest Thief's Hat
Description: "She stole my heart right in front of me."

Name: Isabella's Amulet
Description: This amulet is ancient and powerful. It bears a fresh inscription: "spem relinquere somniantibus."

Name: Forgotten Vow
Description: "No one gives this ring with cruel intentions."

Name: Keepsake Of The Divines
Description: "A gift from beings that no longer see fit to grace us."

Name: Surgeon's Ring
Description: Taken from a startlingly skilled butcher, it was intentionally lost.

Name: Fanciful Earring
Description: You fear that you've imagined this earring. It's not to easy to tell truth from fiction in The Tempest.

Name: Isabella's Rapier
Description: Taken from the Corrupted Queen herself. You feel it tug at your sanity.

Name: Neishatun's Breastplate
Description: The corruption slithers around you; insidious and at the edge of your mind.

Name: Neishatun's Helm
Description: The corruption slithers around you; insidious and at the edge of your mind.

Description: A slab of stone is good enough for cleaving demonic beasts.

Name: Afterthought
Description: Many don't consider what will happen to their soul after death. Such fools always become lost souls searching for release.

Name: Dark Blessing
Description: It was forged for a powerful nun many moons ago, but on the night of its christening a corrupted being blessed it instead of the High Priest, forever tainintg this holy tool.

Name: Simon Grey's Shambles
Description: Once a proud researcher's regalia, Grey's clothes are now tattered and spiked with shambling paranoia.
