Name: Cavern Lurker's Defense
Description: "Light is a rare commodity deep in the caves. One must be ready to defend themselves."

Name: Nakashima's Keepsake
Description: A necklace with an etching of someone the former wearer held close to their heart.

Name: Frozen Mire
Description: "The grime of winter's end always leaves its mark."

Name: Simon Grey's Toothpick
Description: "Clearly Simon Grey did not brush his teeth."

Name: Excavator's Safety Helmet
Description: "Digging around ruins is risky business. One must take as many precautions as possible."

Name: Tomb Raider's Rifle
Description: "Settle in, we're going raiding!"

Name: Burial Spear
Description: "It was once tradition to bury the dead with a weapon so that they could defend themselves in the afterlife. Of course, that tradition stopped once the dead would get right back up and begin fighting you with that weapon."

Name: Simon's Hacksilver Ring
Description: Simon's ring appears to be fashioned from small silver baubles found on his travels.

Name: Flare Spark
Description: "When lightning hits the ground, fire leaps forth."

Name: Staff of the Befouled Temple
Description: "Dark forces run wild in the caverns of Amrine Temple. Only the light can purge them."

Name: Obsidian Edged Musket
Description: "The dark black rock makes this a beautiful rifle."

Name: Graveguard's Seal
Description: An ancient insignia suspended from a chain.

Name: Creeping Cold
Description: "It sneaks up on you. Before you know it, you're shivering. Then you're dead."

Name: Staff of the Immolated Veil
Description: "Ever burning fire guides the way."

Name: Sunderstrike
Description: "No armor can withstand the might of my axe."

Name: Obsidian Rapier
Description: "The obsidian is sharpened and tempered, a fine blade."

Name: Fanged Ring
Description: A ring featuring fang-like protrusions.

Name: Masquerade Mask
Description: A simple but fun wooden mask.

Name: Glacial Longsword
Description: A deep blue hue and a frosty aura make this sword appear as if it is forged in pure ice.

Name: Fleeting Reality
Description: "The weapon seems to shift in and out of this plane of reality. It's neither entirely here nor entirely not."

Name: The Obelisk
Description: "Let this hammer be a pillar of destruction. Sow fear and despair everywhere you go."

Name: Ancient Heartstring
Description: "She had my heart in the palm of her hand, and then she let it go."

Name: Tip of the Morning Star
Description: "The fine point shines in the light of the stars."

Name: Stonehewn Ring
Description: A ring of stone, polished as smooth as glass.

Name: Rapier of Forgotten Queens
Description: "Buried among the tombs of queens past, forgotten among the masses of generous rulers the realm had known."

Name: Promise of Power
Description: "Do not resist. I possess that which you desire."

Name: Farseer's Spear
Description: "Gaze into my crystals and see your future."

Name: Dreadwake
Description: “The feared pirate commander succumbed to the corruption. His ship would appear around the shores of Aeternum, his axe in hand, and all that followed was death and destruction.”

Name: Glowing Lifecrystal Staff
Description: "The crystal tipped staff radiates pure life energy, healing all around it."

Name: Flamewake
Description: "All that remains in my path is ash and dust."

Name: Tempest's Call
Description: "She called for me to find Her, and so I left a trail of blood in my wake as I sought Her out."

Name: Taiyings Heart
Description: "Ambition. Loss. Victory. Defeat. The heart endures."

Name: Zealous Embrace
Description: "May you find others who seek your cause, and the power to destroy those that do not."

Name: Accursed End
Description: "Your destiny was never your own. From the beginning my curse was upon you."

Name: Frostforged War Hammer
Description: "The entire weight of the tundra lingers behind your swing."

Name: Bow of the Enchantress
Description: "Sing my song and receive my power."

Name: Madman's Headhunter
Description: "None are safe when the madman is on the loose."

Name: Inner Peace
Description: "Now that your enemies are dead, I hope you find peace."

Name: Pirate's Piece
Description: The extra loudness intimidates its foes.

Name: Wodao
Description: A sword shipped in from faraway from Aeternum. It is of excellent make, as many have safely staked their lives on it in the past.

Name: Traveler's Flail
Description: A traveler brough a curious weapon from a faraway land. It had lost much of its purpose, but still served them well.

Name: Duplicitous Intent
Description: "My intentions surely are pure."

Name: Rejected Sacrifice
Description: "Not good enough. NOT. GOOD. ENOUGH. Begone, and show your face here no longer!"

Name: Ethereal Visage
Description: "A faint image stained her sight, giving glimpses of a promising future. Or perhaps, her forgotten past."

Name: Willing Sacrifice
Description: “They endlessly throw themselves upon our blades, but for what purpose?"

Name: Corruption's Resurgence
Description: "We thought that corruption was gone, dying a slow death. And then out of nowhere, it erupted."

Name: Voidsong
Description: "Listen closely and hear my promises of power."

Name: Corruption Infused Longbow
Description: "Corruption seeps from the wood around the bow, oozing from every bow. Knocking an arrow causes the corruption to jut towards the fresh wood, trying to corrupt every last splinter of it."

Name: Thorpe's Helmet
Description: Once deeply infused with corruption, it now seems to offer protection against that same dark power.

Name: Desecrated Maul
Description: "An unholy presence lingers around this War Hammer. What was once a weapon of virtue and justice now serves a far darker purpose."

Name: Dark Pyromancer's Spellstaff
Description: "The coven's pyromancers were among the most powerful beings on Aeternum, controlling forces that were not meant to be controlled."

Name: Abyssal Strike
Description: "A weapon of justice and holy intent turned into a weapon of malice."

Name: Frostwall
Description: "A winter storm ebbs and flows within you. Attune yourself to it, and you will find a font of power."

Name: Tundra Warden's Rifle
Description: "Strange beasts lurk on the fringes of the tundra. You never know what you'll run into."

Name: Cave Crawler
Description: It was so named by a frightened adventurer who mistook this gun for a monstrous grub.

Name: Bloodblade
Description: While not forged in blood, it does certainly seem to have an affinity for the substance.

Name: Corrupted Faith
Description: After so many years trapped in a heavily corrupted cave even a pious man would not be the same, much less a humble weapon.

Name: Droplet
Description: A favorite of many sailors as mass-produced goods remind them of home.

Name: Damp
Description: You can feel the cold claiming your finger.

Name: Teardrop
Description: A tear shed for a soul lost.

Name: Iridescence
Description: It shines brightly enough to keep wayward souls at bay.

Name: Brinicle
Description: The cold is freezing you, arm first.

Name: Grasp
Description: Its grip will never leave you.

Name: Expanse
Description: It hates to be confined. It's time to set it free.

Name: Melting Point
Description: Its heat will be comforting in the Deep.

Name: Soul Spine
Description: A poor lost soul has lost more than its purpose.

Name: Maul of Fathoms
Description: It bears the weight of the seas, and will not let you forget it.

Name: Priscilla's Shield
Description: Stolen from a tragic corpse by the seas that pounded it.

Name: Driftwood
Description: Brittle and infectious. I wouldn't use it personally, but to each their own.

Name: Arrowspine
Description: Weak wood usually doesn't make for a strong bow.

Name: Deep Hole
Description: It only gets darker the further down you go.

Name: Explorer's Friend
Description: A practical tool for any intrepid explorer.

Name: The Hook
Description: A pirate's best friend. As dangerous as it is intimidating.

Name: Brodesode
Description: Named by a man who had lost most of his teeth. It stayed in his possession about as long as his molars.

Name: Quaint Helm
Description: A simple piece of armor, favored by its wearer for its cost.

Name: Waterlogged Shirt
Description: You hesitate to put this on as it drips all over you.

Name: Shoes of Seine
Description: Waterlogged and mushy, but it at least doesn't seem to be seawater inside the soles.

Name: Lost Souls Gloves
Description: Souls have never been good at keeping track of their belongings it seems.

Name: Wanderers Pants
Description: Their wearer wandered the world, and these pants wandered the seas.

Name: Song of the Sea
Description: The sword seems to quietly hum in its scabbard to a strangely familiar tune.

Name: Firewood
Description: Forests shiver at its name.

Name: Mastwrap
Description: It was a shoddy weapon thrown together from recently unneeded parts of the flailing ship. It didn't serve its creator long, though that has nothing to do with its craftsmanship.

Name: Tear of Aset
Description: It is said to have dropped from the eye of the mother.

Name: Soulbinding Band
Description: It does not bind two souls together, but instead, a soul to a form.

Name: Priestess Charm
Description: A protective charm used by a powerful priestess. It is said that this charm is what gave her the terrifying strength she was known for, but only ever said in whispers.

Name: Staff of the Throne
Description: The staff of the mother who protects this land.

Name: Hand of Jupiter
Description: It was named by a frightened legion soldier who had never seen such magic before.

Name: Claw of Orcus
Description: Such dark power can only come from the underworld.

Name: Mnevin Staff
Description: This staff was used to worship the bull-god of a long dead civilization. The god's true name has been lost to time.

Name: Dja of Bes
Description: A sturdy spear any soldier can rely on.

Name: Beastfang
Description: Such weapons are a rarity in the sands.

Name: Ornament of Legates
Description: This weapon was brought as ornamentation by a foolish commander.

Name: Wall of Stone
Description: "We shall be as the stone. Immovable and immutable."

Name: Ligo
Description: A simple tool meant for digging and construction.

Name: Charioteer's Bow
Description: A weapon as revolutionary as this cannot be lost to time. None shall forget it.

Name: Buchis Rage
Description: The rage of a beast lives within this weapon.

Name: Arquebus
Description: How did such a strange weapon arrive in this sandy land?

Name: Sobek's Hunger
Description: You feel your stomach emptying slowly as you swing this axe.

Name: Legate's Pride
Description: The pride of the invading soldiers is shown with this spoil of war.

Name: Darion's Spatha
Description: This sword was better cared for than anything else Darion had. It will serve you well for many years if you care for it as well.

Name: The Blue Crown
Description: A powerful headdress worn by a powerful leader.

Name: Lorica Squamata
Description: Tough and reliable legion armor. This is a newer style that is still being experimented with.

Name: Simple Skirt
Description: The passage of time has strangely granted such a simple creation value to the people who found it. It's owner must not have thought much if they had lost it so easily in the sands.

Name: Honorable Shoes
Description: Shoes worn by nobles past. Whether or not they are truly honorable would be best answered by the masses.

Name: Guardian's Gauntlets
Description: These gauntlets will protect you well. Be sure to protect others in kind.

Name: Lost Time
Description: This was certainly not a creation of these ancient civilizations, but after so many years in a land out of time, is this truly the strangest occurence?

Name: Heart of Fire
Description: The heated core must be what this was named for.

Name: Embers of Change
Description: "The future lies not in the ashes of past, but in the embers that will ignite our passion for change."

Name: Wandering Expedience
Description: A rather fancy name for an earring that simply makes you better at walking.

Name: Cleric's Walking Staff
Description: Regret is a heavy weight to bear, and time does it no favors.

Name: Handwarmer
Description: Despite the icy exterior your hand feels quite cozy in there.

Name: Daemongrasp
Description: It was used by many warlocks in the past to steal the power of demons.

Name: Sulfurous Shrapnel
Description: Quite the unique magical staff, as it fires superheated stones instead of simply magical power.

Name: Firestarter
Description: A simple spear, with a simple name. It saw more use as a tool than as a weapon.

Name: Allegro
Description: It best suits an energetic wielder.

Name: Heavy Knocker
Description: This weapon has seen many as a weapon and a door knocker.

Name: Broad Buckler
Description: A dependable and reliable shield. It should serve any wielder well.

Name: Fire of Battle
Description: A desire for combat wells up within you as you wield this weapon.

Name: Heatshot
Description: The arrows launched from this bow seem warmer when you go to reclaim them.

Name: Sparkpowder
Description: This blunderbuss was assembled with a slight defect that, when fired, may also fire flames.

Name: Brash Opener
Description: A relic of a time long past when armies met to fire a report into the opposing force.

Name: Mauler's Axe
Description: A weapon best suited to tearing your foes apart.

Name: Hunting Blade
Description: What would one hunt with such a weapon?

Name: Firelash
Description: The unfortunate souls to suffer this weapon feel as though the fire licks at their wounds.

Name: Scholar's Wear
Description: A piece of simple clothing worn by many aspiring scholars of the Aetheric Arts.

Name: Well-trodden Shoes
Description: The shoes have seen far more of the world than their wearer ever did.

Name: Withering Gloves
Description: These gloves have only ever been worn by those of an advancing age. As their new wearer, you feel it may not have been coincidental...

Name: Warrior's Respite
Description: You feel a comforting warmth reverberate throughout this breaastplate.

Name: Ranger's Focus
Description: Your eyes seem to be getting sharper as you wear this for longer.

Name: Penitent Flame
Description: An old tool from an old time. We've evolved beyond physical penitence to the far more civilized mental anguish.

Name: Long Winter
Description: The chill felt when weilding this gauntlet is inescapable. As is the wrath it can unleash in the right hands.

Name: Abyssal Reckoning
Description: It's rumored that this gauntlet can provide unspeakable power, but among these rumors are whispers of an unspeakable price that must be paid.

Name: Two-Face
Description: Many fierce warriors have been stabbed in the back with this spear's sharp point, most often by someone they thought to be their ally.

Name: Unanswered Question
Description: Careful inspection of this sword prompts more questions than it reveals answers. However, one thing is for certain, it's great at spilling blood.

Name: Hybris
Description: Its unwieldy power has proved to be the downfall of all those who tried to tame it. Perhaps you will be different?

Name: Lady of the Ancient
Description: A beautiful face is carefully etched into this weapon's side. It's unclear who this face was, but it's likely they were once revered by the Ancient.

Name: Ritual's Call
Description: Carefully crafted so that when struck hard enough, a beautifully resonant sound is released. It's thought to have been used as part of Ancient rituals, but there's likely many secrets hidden in its thoughtful design.

Name: Signal
Description: It's hard not to notice an arrow launched from this bow. Somehow every shot seems to shine bright and hiss loudly.

Name: Purefire
Description: "Nothing cleanses like a raging flame."

Name: Illwhisper
Description: Although its words are indistinguishable, you know it speaks of ill omens.

Name: Dusktear
Description: The night sky peeks out the wounds it makes.

Name: Swiftspark
Description: "At the snap of my fingers, sparks will fly."

Name: Soulflare
Description: "The most noble souls burn the brightest."

Name: Energizing Charm
Description: This earrings original purpose is unknown, but its beauty still inspires.

Name: Ribshatter
Description: Not even the mightiest armor will stop it from breaking bones.

Name: Lithespear
Description: An important piece of a long forgotten dance, yet lethal it remains.

Name: Dreadscream
Description: "A scream echoes, nobody is around to hear it."

Name: Scarlet Slayer
Description: No matter how much it's cleaned, its blade remains scarlet stained.

Name: Razortrick
Description: A relic from a time of subterfuge and trickstabs.

Name: Culling Burn
Description: "A controlled burn keeps the forest healthy."

Name: Thunder's Roar
Description: Each shot deafens with its fury.

Name: Blazeclaw
Description: Its infernal grasp is strong, ready for the most brutal engagement.

Name: Meteor's Impact
Description: "The stars plummet, for I asked them to."

Name: Forest Stalker's Earring
Description: "Stick to the trees and stay out of sight."

Name: Timberleech
Description: Subtle hints of life crawl all across the wood.

Name: Bushfire
Description: "All it could do was spread and consume."

Name: Swarmbuster
Description: Strength in numbers is meaningless against a hammer such as this.

Name: Cornerstorm
Description: "Back against the wall, I cry out, and she listens."

Name: Sharp Static
Description: As you sleep the ring on, your hair stands on end.

Name: Static Shock
Description: You feel its charge flow through you, seeking an enemy.

Name: Frostsurge
Description: A cool wind blows, and the gauntlet pulses with power.

Name: Ancestor's Blessing
Description: "Go. Make us proud."

Name: Bonewrecker
Description: Devastate your foes by wrecking their very foundation.

Name: Spirittrap
Description: "There is no escape for the spirits I hunt."

Name: Nimbolt
Description: "With a flash of light, I have let loose a dozen arrows."

Name: Cindersweep
Description: Witness the beauty of the flames, streaking across the sky with each swipe.

Name: Butcher's Delight
Description: "Keep them coming, I can cleave all day."

Name: Feral Cleaver
Description: "My only fear is running out of foes to cleave."

Name: Lightning's Whisper
Description: "What did you say? I couldn't hear you."

Name: Grip of Decay
Description: All flesh succumbs to the void within its grasp.

Name: Nimble Eye
Description: A keen eye protects from even hidden dangers.

Name: Vortex Cannon
Description: Emboldened by the void, its booming shots wreak havoc.

Name: Gloomfury
Description: "A dark cloud approaches the battlefield. Gloomfury has arrived."

Name: First Freeze
Description: "We thought we were ready for the winter, but nothing could prepare us for this."

Name: Righteous Heart
Description: "The righteous shall prosper, for their strength lies deep."

Name: Mystic Sting
Description: "One precise sting was enough, he would never fear again."

Name: Plaguehunt
Description: "The hunt is on, and the cure is gone."

Name: Stormscorcher
Description: "I sit at the eye of the storm, a tempest of flames surrounds me."

Name: Nimble Heart
Description: "The heart dances, so that it may lift the hearts around it."

Name: Sparking Ring
Description: Sparks fly from the surface of this ring when even lightly grazed by metal.

Name: Crosshack
Description: With the right technique, it yields unfathomable power.

Name: Grimsand
Description: "Fate shifts and settles like sand, yet I fight on."

Name: Spelldancer
Description: "Join me for this dance?"

Name: Lost Shiver
Description: Its presence is felt, a tingle on the back of your neck.

Name: Agonizer
Description: "They will suffer, just as I have."

Name: Illspirit
Description: "My soul aches, with no remedy in sight."

Name: Voidstealer
Description: "All you hold dear is nothing in the face of the void."

Name: Spiritpool
Description: "Spirits stew so that great power may come forth."

Name: Blastdrain
Description: Nothing escapes the pull of its earthshattering grenades.

Name: Stubborn Cyclone
Description: "For as long as I stand, I will fight."

Name: Deadeye's Defiance
Description: "I will never miss again."

Name: Swifthail
Description: "No matter how clear the sky, violent hail is just a moment away."

Name: Scourge of the Depths
Description: "I know not where this blight came from. I pray that we never find out."

Name: Unyielding Cleaver
Description: Flesh, armor, bone. Its all the same to a blade that never wavers.

Name: Grimbolt
Description: Even a missed strike instills deep dread.

Name: Infernal Dread
Description: You feel a deep discomfort at the power emanating from this staff.

Name: Spinechiller
Description: As long as its wielded, the tingle on your spine never ceases.

Name: Second Strike
Description: "The first was just to soften them up."

Name: Hunter's Grace
Description: "I leap from tree to tree, my mark never escaping my eyes."

Name: Companion's Courage
Description: "She will never falter, as long as they're by her side."

Name: Dicer
Description: A favorite weapon of the foolish thief who stumbled their way into the Forge many years ago.

Name: Rough-houser
Description: A mass produced piece stolen from the Empyrean Forge many years ago. It was named by a foolish thief who sought to steal other such 'treasures' in his final, ill-fated venture.

Name: Damascan Shot
Description: It was named by an ignorant wielder, for what else but Damascan Steel could house such power?

Name: Magick Empowerment
Description: Inlaid with gems that were unearthed during the construction of the Empyrean Forge. This piece at least passed time until the Forge was properly completed.

Name: Brawlers Memento
Description: Silver was an experimental material in the forge, and helped to create such an experimental item as this.

Name: Silencing Step
Description: A bit of slag came out in an interesting and was experimented with by a bored individual in the Forge. Its close proximity to such powerful energies imbued it with power beyond an ordinary earring.

Name: Forging Staff
Description: There are many ways to generate heat for forging, and, well, magic just tends to be convenient.

Name: Frosthearth
Description: The cold of an unused hearth is a special kind of solemn.

Name: Shizaru's Lance
Description: A sturdy Lance, wielded by Shizaru The Storm.

Name: Fist of Stercus
Description: Heavy fists rained down, blow after blow.

Name: Sprout of Life
Description: The greatest trees often start as the smallest acorns.

Name: Rulav's Bite
Description: The edge on this axe is as keen as the laugh of its former owner.

Name: Felicia
Description: The words "For My Love" are inscribed under the guard.

Name: Hawkish Rebuke
Description: The keenest eye matched with the quickest draw. No one could challenge them together.

Name: Ten Penny Tenny
Description: Ten Pence for the Barman, Ten for the Undertaker.

Name: Stephanus' Masterpiece
Description: He struck the iron for fifteen days. The irons and anvils crumbled, but he stayed strong.

Name: Baldwyn's Rage
Description: Never step between a forgemaster and their work. You're liable to lose a limb.

Name: Eye of the Storm
Description: They'll never forget the stench of powder and the heat of the blast.

Name: Frost of the North
Description: A cold wind blows. An ice crystal grows.

Name: Deadly Reach
Description: Remember that your arm is bolstered by a meter of cold steel.

Name: The Oldest Way
Description: I am but a healer. I think nothing of the promises of men.

Name: Mizaru's Needle
Description: The cut is not meant to be deep, not at first.

Name: Deadblow
Description: Rocks broken, armor cracked. All that remains is a stern reminder of the death blow.

Name: Storming Sea
Description: A tempest by any other name is still a danger.

Name: The Cutlass' Word
Description: Let it be the last word a commander must use.

Name: Devouring Hand
Description: Consume. Consume. Consume.

Name: The Blizzard's Will
Description: I fear to tread where the snow tries to push me.

Name: Scorching Iron
Description: A fine, if rather blackened and charred, old musket.

Name: The Sun in Winter
Description: Where there is light there is heat.

Name: Gawain's Defiance
Description: A towering defense. Only conquered once.

Name: The Green Giant
Description: A sharp reminder to always honor your bargains.

Name: Fireblast
Description: A friendly-looking staff.

Name: Mary's Pain
Description: It is a shield that has weathered countless blows.

Name: Havelock's Neglect
Description: "He and his work lived on. His mind, however..."

Name: Messenger of the Damned
Description: "It was a simple message. They were coming, and they were very well prepared."

Name: Wicked Muzzle
Description: "You have a feeling the bite may be worse than the bark in this case."

Name: Nature's Recourse
Description: "There is a deep sense of comfort hidden within the forest, and an even deeper sense of sorrow."

Name: Dauntless Cry
Description: "Dive in, headlong. Let the enemy know you approach. It's fairer that way."

Name: Fanged Mask
Description: A trimmed, plate mask.

Name: Dreadscythe Scar
Description: "It was a small price to pay, given the alternative."

Name: Hierophant's Ascension
Description: "The sky would open and welcome them, breathing an ancient power into their soul. You would join them."

Name: Freebooter's Bounty
Description: "Aye, to another ripe pillage! Hand me that drink there, will ye? No, no, not that one... that one's yours, lad."

Name: Carved Mask
Description: A carved wooden mask.

Name: Carved Mask
Description: A carved wooden mask.

Name: Protector's Vindication
Description: "Eventually they would be the one that is saved. Unfortunately, that would come long past their time."

Name: Burden of Despair
Description: "Not for what is or has been, but for what is to come."

Name: Malevolent Defender
Description: "While nature is quite adept at reclaiming things lost to time, it is more efficient to not lose them in the first place."

Name: Mark of Suppression
Description: "Less of a warning for the wearer as it is for those who have the misfortune of seeing it."

Name: Carved Mask
Description: A carved wooden mask.

Name: Carved Mask
Description: A carved wooden mask.

Name: Turkey's Bane
Description: "If turkeys have nightmares, it's nightmares of this."

Name: Tremendous Shout
Description: "Hey, over here! No not that way! To the left! No, my left, not your left!"

Name: Assassin's Flugelhorn
Description: "A clever killer finds many solutions to the same problem before committing to one."

Name: The Tipping Point
Description: "The first time this trigger was squeezed, it started a war."

Name: Troublemaker
Description: "Some people make trouble, some people solve trouble. This does both."

Name: Tempestuous Poetry
Description: "She whispers like an ocean storm."

Name: A Stunning Silence
Description: "There's a moment after the shot when nothing can hear anything."

Name: Rabbit Hunter's Blunderbuss
Description: "Whatever its initial purpose, this weapon has moved onto more sinister things."

Name: The Thunderbuss
Description: "What's in a name?"

Name: Troublemaker 9000
Description: "A true warrior would have immediately asked about the little, red lever on the side of the gun."

Name: Hope Manifest
Description: To manifest light amidst darkness is to first endure darkness without light.

Name: Executioner
Description: The arbiter of death is not spared the brutality of his actions; to cull life is akin to culling one’s own.

Name: Keen Temper
Description: "Hone thyself, straight and sharp, and find that no obstacle will ever again be too great."

Name: Falmea's Wrath
Description: A warm presence emanates from this staff, hoping her strength is worthy of the one whom wields her.

Name: The Huntress
Description: This bow’s design is inspired by a legendary weapon, although it has a sentimental feeling as if it were the real thing.

Name: Keen Resolve
Description: "Brace thyself, sturdy and strong, and find that no obstacle will ever again be too great."

Name: Agar's Least
Description: The first sword chosen can be the most familiar in hand, but is more often the sign of a desperate man.

Name: Right Hand of Frost
Description: A cold wind follows the path of this clenched fist.

Name: Left Hand of Deceit
Description: "Why does this glove only fit on my right hand?"

Name: Roman Discipline
Description: "Keep formation, guard your neighbor, trust your commander."

Name: Curse of the Descending Sun
Description: Blows from the furthest reach strike with the most fury.

Name: The Band of Set
Description: Chaos and sand.  All that ever comes is chaos and sand.

Name: Amalgamation
Description: Together. Whole. We are as One.

Name: Primordial Flame
Description: Travel to the Crux of the World, and you will find the Source.

Name: Tidings of Good Fortune
Description: There will always be Light ahead.

Name: Unbearable
Description: "Well, I mean the BEAR can't use it anymore.  What else should I call it?"

Name: The Hard Way
Description: There is an easier way to defeat a Gorgon.  You did not take that path.

Name: Red Nose of Doom
Description: Fire and Smoke. The Sleigh has been lead to its demise, and from the sulfur and ash comes ruin.

Name: Pillar of Winter
Description: There was only one ship.  Inside it, the man with two minds and the captain who would be corrupted. But seasons change, and now the way is frozen.

Name: Worn Upon Stone
Description: The thinner blade fooled the passer-by.  They thought it could be removed.  Vines strangled the unwary, and so sat the stone, unmoved.

Name: Sharp Eyes
Description: The shots are taken from the grass, the tree, the cliffs.  All you need is enough ammunition and sharp eyes.

Name: Legion's Left Hand
Description: An army's legs last as long as its supply chain.  An army's heart lasts as long as its homeliness.

Name: Frostclaw
Description: "The swipe of the massive paw nearly took my head as I ducked and drew my bow.  Will the arrow find its mark in the belly? Or be deflected by steel-like hide and muscle?"

Name: Tooth and Claw
Description: Nature is a beast.  Unruly, untamed. Life will always break free, painfully, even dangerously.

Name: Root
Description: A vine will creep, and settle across vast distances looking for sun, but it will always connect to a base.

Name: Leaf and Stem
Description: The world is not a collection of beasts moving across a dull background.  Those plants are survivors, and you would do well to respect them.

Name: Draught of Death
Description: There is power beyond the veil, all you need do is drink.

Name: Weight of the Mighty
Description: "Their footfalls can be heard for miles. Their breath is like a furnace. Their blows like an avalanche."

Name: Frozen Federfechter
Description: Sturdy Rapier, with a tip that burns like Ice.

Name: Moltmasher
Description: Warhammer with the heft and swing of burning stone.

Name: Bolt Barker
Description: "A clap like thunder, a crater filled with glass."

Name: Hunter's Eye
Description: A sturdy bow for a hunter with the vision to change the world.

Name: Pokey
Description: "Yes, I know how a sword works. The pointy end goes into the other men."

Name: Splitter
Description: Trees, Shields, Walls, Skulls. It doesn't matter which.

Name: Gemma's Ear Pebble
Description: Its definitely supposed to be a good luck charm.  Not sure if it worked.

Name: Short Stick
Description: "The name is crudely engraved on the pommel. I can only imagine what "Long Stick" might look like."

Name: Missed Buckshot
Description: Putting the "blunder" in Blunderbuss.

Name: Pin-Hole Blower
Description: "You take the powder in, get it nice into the tube, then smack the pin hole!  Puts the spark right up the pan, and BOOM!"

Name: Hoof and Tusk
Description: Try to stop the wall of ivory, keratin, and flesh.  It will trample you.

Name: Wrecker
Description: Swing Hard, Swing Strong, Have Fun.

Name: Drown Drown Drown
Description: You will drink. You will drown. You will be disposed of.

Name: Our Destiny
Description: We knew it was our destiny to roam free.

Name: Abyss Walker
Description: She walked in the abyss. She held it, gazed into it. No one questioned whether it gazed back.

Name: Teacup
Description: Here lies a Tempest.

Name: Bunyan's Axe
Description: "Paul? Yeah, I knew him. No finer woodsman ever walked this land."

Name: Kain's Ring
Description: The ring is an echo of his power. His essense seeps into the very air from it.

Name: Steel Six Draw
Description: Six points, six edges, six attacks.

Name: Whiplash
Description: "Crack went the whip! We could not stop, but for the master's lash."

Name: Brace Under Fall
Description: Dig the haft into the ground, point the spearhead up as the bear falls upon it.

Name: The Dueler
Description: "It's pronounced "Duelist."" "Truly I do not care."

Name: Well of Souls
Description: We all draw life from the same breaths.

Name: Enflamed Chaos
Description: An impossible flame. It seems to burn without a source, all-consuming, and without relent.

Name: Frozen Fire
Description: It is fire, but cold to the touch. It must come from some special hell.

Name: Strange Tooth
Description: "I think this shield is... made of teeth of a bizarre density."

Name: Totemic Power
Description: We put stock in symbols, deities, totems, to give us strength.

Name: The Rat King
Description: A forest of tiny swords, held by a legion of tiny hands.

Name: Black Talons
Description: Her life meant peace in the grove. Her death brought chaos to all.

Name: Bulwark
Description: Impregnable. Impenetrable. Unassailable.

Name: Eagle's Beak
Description: Sharp keratin can split flesh and crush bone.

Name: Crack
Description: The sound of a whip.

Name: Cantilever
Description: A far reach can be supported by a stable base.

Name: Swipe
Description: The swing of the axe feels like a swipe from massive claws.

Name: Flashpowder
Description: Smoke and ash, nothing more.

Name: Rhinestone
Description: A glittering gem, embedded on the ear of a mighty warrior.

Name: Kernel
Description: Only a seed, but it can grow into a mighty tree.

Name: Heat of the Moment
Description: The most violent acts can be committed in the heat of the moment.

Name: Dragon's Tail
Description: "You thought the dangerous end was the front, didn't you?"

Name: Fury
Description: The untamed fury of the wilderness will drive away all but the bravest souls.

Name: Nemesis
Description: I have many names. Rival. Antagonist. Villain.

Name: Ares' Will
Description: The god of war was a force to be reckoned with.

Name: Thanatos' Will
Description: Death creeps behind.  Like a fire, it consumes all, as quickly or as slowly as it desires.

Name: Hades' Fury
Description: Do not cross the King of the Underworld.

Name: Hesperian Gardener
Description: This is a paradise. It needs a minder to keep it that way.

Name: Haphestus' Ingenuity
Description: To honor a clever craftsman and genius tinkerer, I could not think of a better name.

Name: Lockdown
Description: The weight of a hammer so great that none can lift it.  Only the strongest can hope to move it.

Name: Reputation
Description: It precedes me, by three feet of steel.

Name: Sundrop
Description: A shiny jewel, set in a bright gold band.

Name: Acorn
Description: These trees were my friends. I had tended to them since they were naught but acorns.

Name: Flower Petal
Description: Its beauty belies ferocity, cunning, and terror.

Name: Blade of the Leaf
Description: In nature, a leaf can cut flesh as well as any blade.

Name: Windbite
Description: The cold wind nips at your foes heels.

Name: The Ring
Description: Lock them in and duke it out.

Name: Immolation
Description: A bright pyre can be a very distracting thing.

Name: Bruiser's Axe
Description: An axe of no particular report. It's most noteworthy feature is how many people have wielded it.

Name: Hero of the Hills
Description: A great warrior once wielded this hammer to hold an army off at the pass.

Name: Warcry of the Sentry
Description: A gutteral cry seems to fill your lungs while you protect others with this Greatsword.

Name: Voidblast
Description: Something seems to be reaching out from the muzzle...

Name: Calming Rage
Description: This weapons almost seems to be meditating in your hand.

Name: Havoc
Description: A whirl of sharp points and dangerous slashes.

Name: Fist of Kurok
Description: A proud hammer, a weapon wielded by the chieftain of the troupe.

Name: Footfall
Description: "A thundering came down from the mountain, the heavy footfalls of the stampeding horde."

Name: Not a Monkey
Description: "Truk is not a Monkey, he is an APE!"

Name: A Mad House
Description: "Damn you, you hairy freak!"

Name: Dragon's Scale
Description: A hard shield, basically impenetrable.

Name: Razor's Leaf
Description: Beware the sharp edge of the grass. You can lay down in a field and wake up in blood.

Name: Touch of the Icicle
Description: It feels cold. Cold as death.

Name: Incendior
Description: "Wood, some gunpowder, and a lit match. Sounds like a fun afternoon."

Name: Evolutionary Response
Description: "Everything is an arms race. Fists become Spears, Spears become Bows, Bows become Guns."

Name: Toothpick
Description: Seems small, but sturdy. Should be paired with a fine slab of a shield.

Name: Charon
Description: Remember to bring an obol, as a toll for the ferryman.

Name: Gorilla's Strength
Description: The boulder lands, shattering the earth. Too close for comfort.

Name: Mammoth's Revenge
Description: Trembling earth, shrieking bellows, boiling blood.

Name: Wolf at the Door
Description: The shield is only as strong as the will to hold it.

Name: Pot Shot
Description: "It doesn't shoot real straight, but if you're not really looking to hit anything..."

Name: Orchard
Description: Some scholars dig and dig, and then one day the garden blooms with knowledge.

Name: Nathan's Hammer
Description: The finest craftsmen create the most powerful arcana.  And then there's Nathan.

Name: Nathan's Hammer
Description: The finest craftsmen create the most powerful arcana.  And then there's Nathan.

Name: Firing Line
Description: "On the line! Feet, shoulder width apart! First Line kneel! Second Line ready!"

Name: Hunter's Claw
Description: An unrelenting bow for a hunter with stupendous reach.

Name: Riposte
Description: "Pitiful. Let your sword do the talking!"

Name: Olympian
Description: The body of a god, the willpower of a demon, the luck of a damned soul.

Name: Dark Scream
Description: There is power in the Abyss. Power, and Fear.

Name: Agamemnon
Description: "A noble house, tarnished by a treacherous legacy."

Name: Vine
Description: A grasping tendril, an invasive feeler, ending in a poison barb.

Name: Blaze
Description: Fields of fire, as far as the eye can see.  Only blood will pay for this.

Name: Stubborn Oak
Description: A sturdy shield. There is a deep sense of safety behind it.

Name: Thorn
Description: The cut is not deep, but you will never reach for the brambles again.

Name: Snowdrift
Description: "We will bury you."

Name: Spirit
Description: "Creatures of the Earth, take leave upon the Wind, Fire upon mine enemies!"

Name: Spinning Wheel
Description: Blood of our mothers, Sweat of our labor, Tears of our widowers.

Name: You're a Beast
Description: "Necessity and scarcity are The Mothers of Invention" - inscription on the underside

Name: Flat Fingers
Description: Keep your hands clear when this unwieldy weapon starts swinging.

Name: Skyward Flail
Description: A weapon uniquely equipped to confront enemies approaching from the sky.

Name: Scorchball
Description: Each of its spikes are red hot.

Name: Dawnstar
Description: "The last lights fade, at the waking of the one most powerful."

Name: Duskstar
Description: "When one light fades, many more are newly revealed."

Name: Fortunate One
Description: Luck follows its faithful wielder.

Name: Shine
Description: This beautiful weapon has a lasting legacy in the north east.

Name: Genesis
Description: This fearsome weapon has a lasting legacy in the south west.

Name: Starbringer
Description: "If we can't reach them, we'll bring them to us."

Name: Ball & Chain
Description: Said to have been made from the shackles of a legendary bandit who never fails to escape prison.

Name: Barebones
Description: Best wielded by a skeleton, but nothing's stopping you from wielding it too.

Name: Defender of the Valley
Description: In a mythical valley lies a small village, it is told this weapon was wielded by its ultimate hero.

Name: Grand Flayer
Description: When you just need to rip something to shreds.

Name: Gothic Encounter
Description: Witnessing this weapon on the battlefield sends shivers down one's spine.

Name: Winged Warbringer
Description: Few are ready for an approach from the sky.

Name: Risky Revenge
Description: "You would risk it all? Just for a drop of vengeance?" "All of it."

Name: Bogswinger
Description: It reeks of a soggy land, home to dozens of hidden bodies.

Name: Archflail
Description: Rumored to have been wielded by a great religious leader. What religion they were a leader of, is entirely unknown.

Name: Redtail
Description: It's bloodsoaked sheen is said to be so bright it you can see a trail of red when swung.

Name: Shimmer
Description: A beautiful shimmer is the last thing the enemy sees before it connects with their head.

Name: Flash Flood
Description: A life-threatening weapon that can appear quicker than you think.

Name: Pub Protector
Description: "A house o' grog is a sacred house indeed"

Name: Tavern Thrasher
Description: A cruel weapon, often used by barbarians to put a damper on good times.

Name: Risk and Reward
Description: What are you willing to put on the line?

Name: Chainsmoker
Description: Despite every link in the chain burning red hot, it keeps it's structural strength.

Name: Metalwhip
Description: What is a flail, if not a metal whip?

Name: Divine Aid
Description: "You call to it, and it's there, when you need it most."

Name: The Lesser Key
Description: It's adorned with various unknown sigils.

Name: Piecemaker
Description: It ends things quicker than lengthy negotiations.

Name: Chaotic Cavalcade
Description: A ferocious weapon and a magnificent show.

Name: Follower's Flail
Description: Some are leaders, and some are followers. But even a follower can have greatness.

Name: Blood Abundance
Description: A weapon that will provide you with more than enough proof of your conquest.

Name: Malicious Agency
Description: "You have free will, why do you use it for evil?"

Name: Pitfall
Description: Humble in appearance, this weapon is far stronger than you may think.

Name: Bruteborne
Description: A weapon that could only be forged by one seeking only brutality.

Name: Swinging Stratagem
Description: "Of course I have a plan, I start swingin."

Name: Hellswing
Description: Hellish flames trail its every swing.

Name: Captivator
Description: An excellent choice to acquire some prisoners of war.

Name: Solidstrike
Description: At times this flail seems like an unstoppable force.

Name: Fairfight
Description: Although called Fairfight, using it in a fight is anything but fair.

Name: Debt Collector
Description: "I'm here to collect."

Name: Regiment
Description: A reliable weapon for any member of a standard fighting force.

Name: Beatdown
Description: Knock your foes down and don't show them any mercy.

Name: Flagellant
Description: Strike your foes and rend their flesh away.

Name: Shield Crusher
Description: "Whoever named this must be a fool. Flails go around shields, they don't destroy shields."

Name: Helm Cracker
Description: A strike upside the head is as good a technique as any in a fight.

Name: Heavy Knight
Description: A dangerous weapon used by many well-trained and well-equipped warriors.

Name: Empty Flail
Description: A strange construction. When it was recreated it had been filled with slag, but the head seems to once again be empty.

Name: Stringent Fate
Description: Fate keeps a tight grip on that which it believes to be its own.

Name: Branchbreaker
Description: The keepers of the forest can't always let it grow unchecked.

Name: Spirituality
Description: Many souls have inhabited this flail over the aeons. And when your time comes, you shall be the next.

Name: Grasping Evil
Description: The depths below have caught you, and they don't intend to let go.

Name: Omnidestructor
Description: "You named this Omnidestructor? Your naming sense is apparently as bad as your workmanship."

Name: Godly Gift
Description: A heavenly weapon, a thoughful gift given to someone centuries ago.

Name: Deathdragger
Description: Where it goes, death follows.

Name: Prime Protector
Description: Some noble souls simply seek to protect others, no matter the context.

Name: Seahawk
Description: "Never imagined a flail to be effective at sea, yet an ancient sea captain proved it so."

Name: Substrife
Description: "Beneath one war there always lies many more."

Name: Backbreaker
Description: One swing is enough to paralyze.

Name: Crow's Call
Description: You hear its distant calls, calls for murder.

Name: Ravencry
Description: A shriek Raven's call precedes every slaughter this weapon aids in.

Name: Divine Dominion
Description: "You've been granted sovereignty over all."

Name: Savvy Swing
Description: "I've never seen a flail used like that before."

Name: Polar Protector
Description: Prepared to protect, in even the coldest of places.

Name: Explorer's Friend
Description: A trusty flail, it never seems to break and is ready for any threat.

Name: Tideturner
Description: The battle always shifts when this glorious weapon arrives.

Name: Rhythmic Ravager
Description: Music from malicious mayhem.

Name: Homegrown Helper
Description: This flail has been passed down for a long time, repaired and reconstructed numerous times.

Name: Trenchthrasher
Description: "They dare to hide from ME?"

Name: Elder End
Description: A weapon that will last you to the very end.

Name: Wise Whisper
Description: You can just barely make out what its saying.... "Duck!"

Name: Divine Steward
Description: "Look after all others as if they are yourself."

Name: Dualswinger
Description: Just when you think you've safely dodge the first strike, the second is already here.

Name: Moon Maiden
Description: Adorned with moon imagery, its believed to be dedicated to an ancient moon goddess.

Name: Serpenteater
Description: A solid piece of gear, it's metal is perfect for bashing dangers of a jungle.

Name: Carrion
Description: Few bodies are left standing once this weapon enter's the battle.

Name: Soulspawn
Description: You can't quite tell, but it seems as if theres a human presence somewhere deep in the flail.

Name: Street Sweeper
Description: Perfect for clearing out street rats.

Name: Life Sentence
Description: Provides a very short life sentence.

Name: Kingmaker
Description: "It's reappeared often throughout history, always in service of a new King"

Name: Flareal
Description: Flames spit out from it when swung.

Name: Ball Berserker
Description: Once it starts swinging, its unstoppable.

Name: Divine Depravity
Description: Great power used by Great Evil.

Name: Coffinmaker
Description: "The undertaker smiles, he knows this weapon is good for business."

Name: Selfstarter
Description: For up and coming warriors.

Name: Sleepwalker
Description: It's said that the one with this weapon is always mysteriously awoken when a danger is near.

Name: Waking Wind
Description: It glistens gracefully in the morning sun.

Name: Solemn Swing
Description: "A very serious weapon, for very serious people."

Name: Sweet Sting
Description: Victory always tastes so sweet.

Name: Repentance
Description: You'll need repentance after the sins you commit with this weapon.

Name: Rebel's Reach
Description: It's reach is farther than it appears.

Name: Fraudster's Fright
Description: Undefeatable by posers and cheats.

Name: Clean Swing
Description: No matter how much havoc it wreaks, it never has a splash of blood on it.

Name: Spikesphere
Description: A simple flail, but extraordinarily powerful.

Name: Fearfinder
Description: A weapon that sniffs out the weak.

Name: Soulstring
Description: An unseen bond ties you to this weapon.

Name: Brashbuster
Description: Sometimes, you just gotta break things.

Name: Defiant Drive
Description: "Few things are more powerful than spite."

Name: Pristine
Description: Although appearing as if never used, this weapon has seen countless battles.

Name: Oathkeeper
Description: A mythic oath powers both this weapon and its wielder.

Name: Oathbreaker
Description: Some believe it takes more strength to break your oath than to keep it.

Name: Eternal Execution
Description: "Even death is no relief."

Name: Close Call
Description: Even a light hit from this weapon is potentially lethal.

Name: The Validator
Description: "A slow strike, a necessary evil."

Name: Nocturnal Watch
Description: "It protects us at night, and we protect it during day."

Name: Prince Provoker
Description: An unmatched weapon that even the most dignified nobility can't help but seeth at.

Name: Holy Cycle
Description: "At its end you will find its beginning."

Name: Scent of War
Description: "A sweet aroma lingers on the horizon; battle is coming."

Name: Killer Protection
Description: Suitable for both saving and slaughtering.

Name: Full Fury
Description: When you've just reached your limit.

Name: Strategist Slayer
Description: Most effective when paired with well laid plans.

Name: Exclusion Zone
Description: Keep threats at a distance, no matter their ferocity.

Name: Brightbuff
Description: A light shines from the ball, the sight of it encouraging the wielder's allies, and frightening their foes.

Name: Chainstrike
Description: "When you connnect once, just keep hitting."

Name: Disposer
Description: To a weapon such as this, every life is disposable.

Name: Price of Providence
Description: "It's not as low as you may think."

Name: Momentous
Description: "Keep the ball rolling and the chains swinging."

Name: Hidden Heat
Description: "It resides deep within, undetectable until ignited by the flames of war."

Name: Tollkeeper
Description: "I'm here to collect."

Name: Arcing Savagry
Description: When wielded properly, it draws glorious arcs of blood across the battlefield.

Name: Lorded Lead
Description: An incredibly strong weapon, thats incredibly hard to wield.

Name: Artificial Anger
Description: "For when the real stuff just wont do."

Name: Skull Seperator
Description: It's never been easier to remove head from body.

Name: Nothing to Lose
Description: "Everything to gain."

Name: Devious Delivery
Description: Not something you want to be on the receiving end of.

Name: Dishonor
Description: A stain that follows you, from the deepest ocean to the highest tower.

Name: Will of Azoth
Description: "None truly know it, though some can hear it"

Name: Starstricken
Description: "The force of its hit is matched only by the bodies in the heavens."

Name: Faithfinder
Description: "One only truly knows their faith when near death."

Name: Thorned Survivor
Description: "The thorns grew, like a protective measure."

Name: Dearly Departed
Description: "Who am I? Who am I?"

Name: Grovelight
Description: A soft light drew you to find this amulet among all others, like a warm grove in the summer.

Name: Soulpollen
Description: "For trees and bushes to have gained sentience on Aeternum, it should be no stretch to even assert they have a soul."

Name: Genesis of Life
Description: Not exactly primal, but it seems to have such an ancient quality that other words feel almost childlike as a comparison for this small trinket.

Name: Lifewell Channeler
Description: This staff draws its power directly from the deep recesses of the earth where the First Lives began.

Name: Boreal Force
Description: Winter is an indelible part of the cycle of the years just as death is a reflection of our lives.

Name: Hunger of the Void
Description: The quiet void has never once forgotten the time before beginnings and will never let us stray too far from it either.

Name: Ignition
Description: "As dangerous as it may be, even fire is an important part of a healthy forest."

Name: Bramblebranch
Description: Jagged and drought-like to the touch. You wonder if it was meant to harm the victim or the wielder.

Name: Clint
Description: You can barely read a simple name is engraved on the hilt, 'Clint'.

Name: Morgol's Maul
Description: An absolute mountain of a woman. Morgol was feared in many corners of Aeternum for her size rather than her temperament.

Name: Arandel
Description: A simple but elegant name, for a simple but elegant shield.

Name: Petrified Trunk
Description: "It may not be as sturdy as iron, but such old azoth touched wood must be sturdy enough, no?"

Name: Spiralseed
Description: If shot true, arrows from this bow seem to dance and scream through the air as they chase a target.

Name: Meatgrinder
Description: Fertilizer is a necessity to caretake a forest of this size and, well, something has to make all of it.

Name: Iceburst
Description: "As the land shifts through time, so too do travelers shift through the land. Leaving all their bloody trash too!"

Name: Hollow Trunk
Description: A bolt of lightning from the blue opened a tree and this fell out. Don't ask me how it got there, I don't know either.

Name: Jackalope Antler
Description: Long thought to be an old wives tale, perhaps such cryptic creatures ended up in Aeternum.

Name: Enchanted Root
Description: As wyrdwood grows taller and taller, it must reach further, and further to find azoth in the soil. Not every root finds the nutrients, and must be abandoned by the trees.

Name: Cleansing Whip
Description: A strange tool to any who are not native caretakers of the forest.

Name: Chrysalid Chitin
Description: It seems to be less of a coat, and moreso a… piece of a cocoon…? But what insect could even be large enough to molt shards this large?

Name: Wandering Helm
Description: This hat has seen many heads in its travels. I really wouldn't recommend wearing it though.

Name: Treetop Down
Description: These pants are soft enough that you feel you can remember what it was like to swing in the treetops.

Name: Moss Stompers
Description: Such heavy boots are invaluable while crossing swamps and moors. Though the denizens of such lands won't appreciate your intrusions.

Name: Berry Pickers
Description: Simple but tough leather is invaluable when trying to gather berries from their protective bushels of thorns.

Name: Passage of Time
Description: It's better to go with the flow, than to vainly fight against it.

Name: Hamstring
Description: This seems to be a keepsake from some kind of graverobbing scum.

Name: Heavy Earring
Description: The extremely dense stones in its craftsmanship have allowed mages to infuse a great deal more azoth into this earring than you would expect.

Name: Ritual of the Hereafter
Description: "Just as we must shepherd those through life, we must also ensure they are guided in death."

Name: Gravelguard
Description: While this may be an ice gauntlet, you'd be a fool to assume the only rock it throws is blue.

Name: Ritual Blessing
Description: An invaluable tool for a guiding cleric. It may not serve you as well in combat as it did its previous owner at the altar.

Name: Flamewood
Description: "You stole my firewood to make a staff? I guess you can keep it, but, why not just go cut down a tree…?"

Name: Second Wind
Description: The second wind is where champions and warriors are made. Usually because that's when people end up dead, and you can't be a winner if you lost.

Name: Hewn Stone
Description: Don't let the rough craftsmanship fool you, it's as sharp as it needs to be to stab you.

Name: Cold Heft
Description: The weight of Winter is more than most expect.

Name: Ancient Protector
Description: Shields have served many well over the milennia. You'd be wise to not ignore them.

Name: Primal Rage
Description: You can feel the fate of the planet in your hands. Fight well.

Name: Snowcoated Shortbow
Description: A frost coated arrow has quite the shock to it when it pierces flesh.

Name: Warhorn
Description: Its blast signals the start of the fight, and the end of a life.

Name: Firing Line
Description: Formation and organization are almost alien concepts to a battlefield such as Aeternum.

Name: Warrior's Shame
Description: "Aim for the back, not only because it’s a bloody large open space, but because it will disrupt your opponent's rhythm and set them on edge."

Name: Stalagmite
Description: A heavy piece of stone that fell off the ceiling of an ancient cave. Or did it come from the ground?

Name: Bouldershard
Description: This blade did not come from a boulder, but due to its size, that's a very reasonable assumption.

Name: Morale
Description: Charge forward into the fray!

Name: Weathered Concrete
Description: Even after centuries of weathering and damage, this helm stands as strong as the Pantheon itself.

Name: Reverent Earth
Description: You feel the slow, muttering prayer of the land while you wear this helmet.

Name: Ancient Anchor
Description: The weight of these leg guards is so great you feel that you can't be moved. Which does pose a problem, as walking tends to be important.

Name: Stonesole
Description: "Gary I hate you so much. Gloves are gloves and shoes are shoes, these aren't even similar."

Name: Stonesoul
Description: "Reg, do you think you could wear these on your feet? Gloves are kinda like shoes but for your hands!"

Name: Cleansing Pod
Description: A small seed pod. It seems the wild growth is spreading further and faster than you could have thought.

Name: Vivify
Description: It seems to have been cleansed and brought into new life. Though what caused such densely corrupted metal to change may be beyond your ken.

Name: Slaked Thirst
Description: The corruption contained within this trinket has been satisfied. For now.

Name: Monk's Prayer
Description: This staff seems to have resisted the opaque corruption surrounding it, perhaps due to the earnest prayers of the monk who used to walk with it.

Name: Frostlife
Description: Another strange magical item for such a densely corrupted deathtrap. Though this one seems to still be in the process of its cleansing. How powerful must this cleansing force be?

Name: Voidrage
Description: The void flows through you to grant you power. As long as you keep it fed, it will keep you strong.

Name: Flame Brawler
Description: A strange choice of weapon, but staves have been a reliable choice for many people defending themselves over the years.

Name: Vicious Slayer
Description: Powerful thrusts to turn your foes to dust.

Name: Razor's Edge
Description: Not a very imposing weapon, but certainly one that will be quite dangerous in skilled hands.

Name: Willpower
Description: A warrior's will of iron cannot simply be shattered.

Name: Smallshield
Description: Such straightforward worksmanship is always something you can rely on. However, it's really quite strange that such a simple shield hasn't yet been corrupted.

Name: Voidwell
Description: Spending so much time in the depths of the void will change even the most immutable of materials.

Name: Darksight
Description: As you feel the depths drag you down, your eyes turn further upwards.

Name: Artillerist
Description: It seems to be a fallen relic from a failed expedition.

Name: Discomfort
Description: If you're willing to step into a strange space you may find this musket to be a reliable partner.

Name: Deadly Cyclone
Description: Just be careful not to get dizzy.

Name: Sharpridge
Description: The corruption doesn't seem to have sharpened the blade, though you're certain it's significantly more dangerous.

Name: Heavenly Punishment
Description: It was dropped from the heavens, as if to curse the malignant corruption.

Name: Commanding Stance
Description: An overflowing confidence from the commander as she leads her men on an ill-fated expedition.

Name: Exploratory Desire
Description: A foolish wanderer to have delved into such malignant corruption in the hungering greed for glittering gold.

Name: Cavernous Thoughts
Description: You feel that this helm has expanded your mind, though you've yet to fill it with anything so it feels rather empty for now.

Name: Devilish Stamina
Description: The unflagging stamina of your demonic foes fills your legs.

Name: Enduring Struggle
Description: The resistance against enduring corruption can never cease.

Name: Fallen Monk's Gloves
Description: A poor lost soul left these behind.

Name: Seafaring Blessing
Description: An old prayer to protect sailors is imbued within this insignificant trinket.

Name: Privateer's Heriloom
Description: A certainly stolen token. It's difficult to justify calling it an 'heirloom' if it was taken from a poor soul on the seas.

Name: Plundered Hoop
Description: A fanciful decoration that used to adorn a pirate's ear.

Name: Swabbing Staff
Description: You make do with what you have in a ship on the seas.

Name: Shardshot
Description: Jagged edges and ridged shards fly from its palm. Even the gauntlet itself stabs at you while you wear it.

Name: Bursting Void
Description: A burst of strength pours forth from your hand and surges outwards.

Name: Lighthouse
Description: A warm light guides you home, and comforts your return.

Name: Boarding Harpoon
Description: A dangerous, but invaluable, tool for any scourge of the high seas.

Name: Captain's Rapier
Description: Arguably more ornamental than functional. Though a weapon is a weapon, even on the sea.

Name: Iceberg
Description: Ice usually is not a particularly dangerous rock, but on the sea it becomes for more concerning.

Name: Jagged Flotsam
Description: A piece of sodden wood adrift for many years. You feel a sense of kinship to its arrival.

Name: Rogue's Tool
Description: Rogueish individuals may be known for more discreet tools, but really anything will do if their victim's back is turned.

Name: Oil Jar
Description: Small jars of oil seem to be enchanted to this bow, though how they are attaching themselves to the arrows it fires remains a syrupy mystery.

Name: Berserking Slayer
Description: You've never known a berserker to be more interested in firing a tool than bludgeoning their foes, but to each their own.

Name: Thick Powder
Description: A unique powder blend makes this musket a bit heavier before you fire, though you do certainly feel lighter afterwards.

Name: Deepaxe
Description: You aren't sure if this axe was named for a dark cavern or the cold depths of the sea, though its circumstances ceratinly imply the latter.

Name: Pirate's Cutlass
Description: "Gary, this isn't a cutlass, it's a longsword at best. You can't just call something what it's not. Yes Gary I know we're Pirates but we have bloody standards."

Name: Mizzenmast
Description: You could argue this to be any old piece of wood, but the sheer size of it implies it must have come from a mast.

Name: Heavy Chain
Description: The heavy chain makes this flail a bit more unwieldy, but definitely more deadly.

Name: Soggy Hat
Description: You'll certainly regret wearing something so… mildewy…

Name: Sinking Petticoat
Description: A captain always goes down with her ship.

Name: Padded Shoes
Description: While not particularly protective, these shoes make for excellent comfort while trapped on a slab of wood in the open water.

Name: Frosted Tips
Description: The gloves make you feel extremely cool.

Name: Thin Britches
Description: While they certainly won't keep the cold out, they also aren't keeping the heat in.

Name: Azoth Battery
Description: The amount of azoth stored in here would astound any scholar.

Name: Fiery Force
Description: A burning heat will leave a mark on your finger if you wear this for too long.

Name: Lifeloop
Description: Life begets energy and energy begets life.

Name: Soft Warmth
Description: The comforting warmth of a soft bed protects you.

Name: Frozen Soul
Description: You can't tell if this gauntlet houses a miserable trapped soul, or is just, really, REALLY cold.

Name: Hatred of the Void
Description: As the void surges forth so too does its hatred at anything within the light.

Name: Hungering Flame
Description: The flames lick at their victim, as if to consume everything about them, down to the last ash.

Name: Spear of the Defender
Description: A protector is a valiant warrior indeed. For what could be more noble than protecting the weak?

Name: Steeleater
Description: Any tool that can rend metal will most certainly also rend flesh.

Name: Hippopotamidaen Strength
Description: "Gary. That's not. Hippopotamidaen isn't a word, Gary. Latin, and also English, don't work that way. And besides, Hippos aren't even real. You shouldn't believe everything a Bard tells you Gary."

Name: Legion Shieldwall
Description: A standard military tactic. Shields up, and spears forward.

Name: Brawling Axe
Description: A weapon more suited to a tavern brawl than a proper duel.

Name: Thundershot
Description: A bolt from the blue.

Name: Mayhem Maker
Description: This gun is not so suited for killing foes as much as it suited for wanton destruction.

Name: Ammit's Hunger
Description: Not a particularly accurate name, but then again, whomever named it certainly isn't familiar with the proper Pantheon.

Name: Slayer's Axe
Description: Not so much a warrior's weapon as it is an executioner's tool.

Name: Finger of Suetekh
Description: Power and energy course through this sword in a way you simply can't comprehend.

Name: Arm of Horus
Description: The power of the Gods comes down upon your foe.

Name: Timelost Flail
Description: A weapon out of time, and in a land out of sync.

Name: Graverobber's Hat
Description: Those who would steal from dead people and dead lands such as these deserve their grisly fates.

Name: Shieldline
Description: A thick undershirt worn by many Heavy Knights underneath their breastplates.

Name: Coalsole
Description: You feel a burning heat on your feet as you walk while wearing these.

Name: Dry Leather Gloves
Description: Many years in the sun has dried out these gloves, you can almost feel them sucking the moisture out of you.

Name: Hearty Pants
Description: These pants are not very regular. They do however make you feel healthier.

Name: Empty Hearth
Description: Cold and empty. You aren't sure if anyone flame could reignite this.

Name: Red Hot Slag
Description: A piece of waste taken from the Empyrean Forge. Ordinarily, you'd be quite foolish to want this, but the lingering energies of the forge have enchanted some amount of power into this.

Name: Charcoal
Description: A piece of valuable fuel for many fires. You however? I have no idea what you're going to do with it.

Name: Fire of Life
Description: The fire of life burns within you.

Name: Snowmelt
Description: It's surprising that this gauntlet has even lasted in the forge for this long.

Name: Brightdark
Description: Even within the creeping recesses of the void, hope can be found.

Name: Volcanic Staff
Description: Explosive power and heat erupt out of this seemingly benign staff.

Name: Firepoker
Description: A useful tool in the forge to stoke the flames. It will probably serve well enough as a weapon.

Name: Knightslayer
Description: Far more adept at slipping between armored plates than it is at slicing through your foes.

Name: Firefight
Description: "Yes. You are fighting 'with fire'. You are technically 'fire fighting', Gary. You are technically not wrong Gary."

Name: Blast Shield
Description: A piece of equipment that had fallen off of a forge. It protected workers from the flames before, so it will likely protect you just as well.

Name: Trickshot
Description: A skillful warrior can put such a weapon to good use.

Name: Old Longbow
Description: The wood composing this bow has charred over the years of exposure.

Name: Shredder
Description: This won't kill your foes as much as it will shred them into piece.

Name: Flamespout
Description: The extra-volatile powder this gun uses makes it spurt flames on shot.

Name: Commanding Strike
Description: A powerful strikes compels the receiver to kneel.

Name: Enduring Will
Description: Stand and fight!

Name: Strikeback
Description: Parry and riposte upon your foes.

Name: Rending Flail
Description: This flail seems to have been rather haphazardly forged, but it's quite good at rending through armor because of that.

Name: Dragonsteel
Description: Dragons may not be real, but that's not enough to stop an enterprising merchant from pumping up his wares to his suckers.

Name: Insulating Helm
Description: The metal this helmet is forged from is unspectacular, but the inner portions make it surprisingly comfortable in the summer.

Name: Darkshroud Leggings
Description: The void slowly drips up your legs as you wear this armor.

Name: Counterbalancing Boots
Description: Heavy armor is difficult to move in, but offers some unique advantages to other equipment.

Name: Scaled Gauntlets
Description: Scaled armor may not be in fashion any longer, but it's no less effective.

Name: Heart of Cold
Description: When all that remains is bitter cold, even the smallest warmth can keep a light aflame.

Name: Forlorn Hope
Description: "Abandon all hope, ye who stand before me."

Name: Hailley's Comet
Description: Gone in a flash.

Name: Aurora's Blessing
Description: Even in the deepest winter night, I will be there to guide you.

Name: Stress Fracture
Description: Apply ice to the afflicted area.

Name: Yeti's Claw
Description: Need a hand?

Name: Frostburn
Description: To wield a cold flame requires a cool temper.

Name: Quick & Painless
Description: You won't feel a thing.

Name: Prick of Death
Description: Merely one touch will grant sleep eternal.

Name: Snowplow
Description: "One way or another, I'm getting through."

Name: Ye Ol' Icebox
Description: Works great for the bears.

Name: Ice Breaker
Description: Ice, stone, bone? Eh, it's all cut the same.

Name: Hail to the King
Description: Kneel to the crown.

Name: Short Alphorn
Description: Yodelayheehoo!

Name: The Mountaineer
Description: "Take a long, deep breath, then slowly release. Three, two, one..."

Name: Avalanche
Description: "No one will find you."

Name: Cold Cuts
Description: Revenge is a dish best served with company.

Name: The Cold, Hard Truth
Description: "The truth is this is going to hurt me a lot more than it hurts you. Do you have any idea how heavy this thing is? Well, you will soon."

Name: North Star
Description: May my guiding light show you shining stars.

Name: Arctic Valkyrian Cuirass
Description: Shimmering plumes of sea ice have formed on this armor, forming a frigid but durable layer of frost.

Name: Arctic Valkyrian Winged Helm
Description: Shimmering plumes of sea ice have formed on this armor, forming a frigid but durable layer of frost.

Name: Arctic Valkyrian Tassets
Description: Shimmering plumes of sea ice have formed on this armor, forming a frigid but durable layer of frost.

Name: Arctic Valkyrian Sollerets
Description: Shimmering plumes of sea ice have formed on this armor, forming a frigid but durable layer of frost.

Name: Arctic Valkyrian Armguards
Description: Shimmering plumes of sea ice have formed on this armor, forming a frigid but durable layer of frost.

Description: A raving madman has warned you this was made with the soul of a Demon. There's no way that's true, right?

Description: A raving madman has warned you this was made with the finger of a Demon. There's no way that's true, right?
